local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

			R[L] = true
			F[#F + 1] = L
		end
	end

		z(L)
	end

	for a, L in ipairs(t8.DEFAULT) do
		if not R[L] and not t8.PINNED[L] and #F > 0 then
			local _ = 1

			for s = a - 1, 1, -1.0 do
				local a = t8.DEFAULT[s]
				local s = table.find(F, a)

				if s then
					_ = s + 1

					break
				end
			end

			table.insert(F, _, L)
			R[L] = true
		end
	end

	for a, a in ipairs(t8.DEFAULT) do
		z(a)
	end

	for a, a in ipairs(t8.DEFAULT) do
		if t8.PINNED[a] and not R[a] then
			R[a] = true
			F[#F + 1] = a
		end
	end

	return F
end

	local z, L = pcall(t11.H.Contains, a, R, F, false, 2)

	return z and L == true
end
t11.threat = function(q, S)
	local F = t11.now()

	for R, z in pairs(t11.hazards) do
		local L = tonumber(z.At) or F
		local _ = tonumber(z.Duration) or 0.5
		local s = F - L

		if s > _ + 0.3 then
			t11.hazards[R] = nil
		elseif -s <= S and not z.Jumpable and z.Kind ~= "Ring" then
			local S = math.max(s, 0)

			for F = 0, 4 do
				if t11.hits(z, q, S + (_ - S) * F / 4) then
					return z
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
t11.jumpSoon = function(a)
	local F = t11.now()

	for R, R in pairs(t11.hazards) do
		if R.Jumpable or R.Kind == "Ring" then
			local z = F - (tonumber(R.At) or F)

			if z > -0.2 and z < 0.25 and t11.hits(R, a, math.max(z, 0) + 0.1) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
end
t11.hop = function(a,S,F,R)local z=S-a.Position;if z.Magnitude>70 then S=a.Position+z.Unit*70;end;local z=F+3;a.CFrame=CFrame.new(Vector3.new(S.X,z,S.Z),R and Vector3.new(R.X,z,R.Z)or Vector3.new(S.X,z,S.Z+1));a.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;end
t11.ring = function(a,S,F,R)local z={};for L=0,F-1 do local _=L/F*math.pi*2;z[#z+1]=Vector3.new(a.X,R+3,a.Z)+Vector3.new(math.cos(_),0,math.sin(_))*S;end;return z;end
t11.bats = function(a)
	local R = genv.__SenaV4Bats
	local F = {}

	for z, z in ipairs({ a, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
		for a, a in ipairs(z and z:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if a:IsA("Tool") and ((R and type(R.isBat) == "function") and R.isBat(a) or (not R and a:GetAttribute("IsBat") == true)) then
				F[#F + 1] = a
			end
		end
	end

	return F
end
t11.cdEnd = function(a)return tonumber(a:GetAttribute('\z  C\o\111l\100\z  ownE\x6Ed\u{0054}\i\me'))or 0;end
t11.step = function(a, R)
	local z = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinArena")
	local S, L = t11.root()

	if not (z and S and L and L.Health > 0) then
		return
	end

	local s = tonumber(z:GetAttribute("FloorY")) or S.Position.Y - 3
	local W, d = z:GetAttribute("Center"), tonumber(z:GetAttribute("Radius")) or 220

	local function M(I)
		return typeof(W) ~= "Vector3" or Vector3.new(I.X - W.X, 0, I.Z - W.Z).Magnitude < d - 15
	end

	local W = z:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local d = t11.target(z)
	local I = a and W == "Shield" and t11.myCannon(z, S) or nil
	local Q = a and t11.bats(_) or {}
	local T = #Q >= 2
	local x = _:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local h = (x and table.find(Q, x)) and x or nil

	if T and (not h or t11.cdEnd(h) > t11.now()) then
		for x, x in ipairs(Q) do
			if not h or t11.cdEnd(x) < t11.cdEnd(h) then
				h = x
			end
		end
	end

	h = h or Q[1]

	if h and h.Parent ~= _ then
		L:EquipTool(h)
		t11.swapAt = os.clock()
	end

	local Q = d

	if I then
		local x = I:FindFirstChild("OperatorZone")
		local k = x and x:IsA("BasePart") and x.Position or I:GetPivot().Position
		local x = I:FindFirstChild("RootHitbox")

		x = x and x:IsA("BasePart") and x or nil

		if I:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true and x then
			if t11.boxDist(x, S.Position) > 9 and not t11.threat(x.Position, 1.5) then
				local B = k - x.Position
				local D = B.Magnitude > 0.5 and x.Position + B.Unit * math.min(6, B.Magnitude) or x.Position

				t11.hop(S, D, s, x.Position)
			end

			Q = x
			t11.status = "Loading the cannon"
		else
			if Vector3.new(S.Position.X - k.X, 0, S.Position.Z - k.Z).Magnitude > 3 and not t11.threat(k, 1.5) then
				t11.hop(S, k, s, d and d.Position)
			end

			if I:GetAttribute("Ready") == true and os.clock() - t11.lastShot > 1.05 then
				t11.shotId += 1
				t11.lastShot = os.clock()
				t11.R.PumpkinBoss.CannonFire:FireServer(t11.shotId)
			end

			Q = x
			t11.status = "Breaking the shield with the cannon"
		end
	elseif d then
		local I = R and t11.threat(S.Position, 0.8) or nil

		if I then
			local I = t11.ring(d.Position, d.Size.X / 2 + 8, 16, s)

			for x, x in ipairs(t11.ring(S.Position, 45, 12, s)) do
				I[#I + 1] = x
			end

			table.sort(I, function(x, k)
				return (x - S.Position).Magnitude < (k - S.Position).Magnitude
			end)

			for x, x in ipairs(I) do
				if M(x) and not t11.threat(x, 3) then
					t11.hop(S, x, s, d.Position)

					break
				end
			end
		elseif a and t11.boxDist(d, S.Position) > 12 then
			local I = t11.ring(d.Position, d.Size.X / 2 + 8, 16, s)

			table.sort(I, function(x, k)
				return (x - S.Position).Magnitude < (k - S.Position).Magnitude
			end)

			for x, x in ipairs(I) do
				if t11.boxDist(d, x) <= 12 and M(x) and not (R and t11.threat(x, 2.5)) then
					t11.hop(S, x, s, d.Position)

					break
				end
			end
		end

		if a then
			t11.status = string.format("Fighting %s  ·  %d HP", tostring(z:GetAttribute("BossName") or W or "boss"), tonumber(z:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0)
		end
	end

	if R and t11.jumpSoon(S.Position) and L.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		L.Jump = true
	end

	if h and h.Parent == _ and Q and t11.boxDist(Q, S.Position) <= 14 and os.clock() - t11.lastSwing > (T and 0.12 or 0.72) and os.clock() - (t11.swapAt or 0) >= (T and 0.15 or 0) then
		if t11.now() >= t11.cdEnd(h) + 0.05 then
			t11.lastSwing = os.clock()
			t11.R.BatSwing.Trigger:FireServer(nil, game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false))
		end
	end
end
t11.collect = function()
	local q = t11.root()
	local R = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinArena")

	if not (q and R) then
		return
	end

	local a = tonumber(R:GetAttribute("FloorY")) or q.Position.Y - 3
	local R, z = t11.now(), {}

	for L, _ in pairs(t11.drops) do
		if (tonumber(_.ExpiresAt) or 0) < R then
			t11.drops[L] = nil
		elseif R >= (tonumber(_.CollectAfter) or 0) and #z < 8 then
			t11.hop(q, _.Position, a)
			RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
			z[#z + 1] = L
		end
	end

	if #z > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			t11.R.PumpkinBoss.Collect:FireServer(z)
		end)
	end
end
t11.leave = function()
	local a = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("PumpkinBossExit")
	local F = t11.root()

	if not F or #a == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local R, z

	for L, L in ipairs(a) do
		local a = L:IsA("BasePart") and L or L:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local _ = a and (a.Position - F.Position).Magnitude

		if _ and (not R or _ < z) then
			R, z = L, _
		end
	end

	if not R then
		return false
	end

	local a = R:IsA("BasePart") and R or R:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local z = R:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	local R = os.clock()

	while t11.alive() and t11.inArena() and os.clock() - R < 4 do
		F = t11.root()

		if F and a then
			F.CFrame = a.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			F.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

			if firetouchinterest then
				pcall(firetouchinterest, F, a, 0)
				pcall(firetouchinterest, F, a, 1)
			end
		end

		if z and fireproximityprompt then
			pcall(fireproximityprompt, z, z.HoldDuration or 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.15)
	end

	return not t11.inArena()
end
t11.claim = function()
	if not t11.mods() then
		return
	end

	local a, F = pcall(function()
		return t11.Save.Peek().HalloweenDimension.BossMastery
	end)

	if not a or type(F) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	local a, R = tonumber(F.Mastery) or 0, F.ClaimedMilestoneIds or {}

	for F, F in pairs(t11.M.Milestones or {}) do
		if type(F) == "table" and F.Id and (tonumber(F.Kills) or math.huge) <= a and not R[F.Id] then
			pcall(function()
				t11.R.HalloweenDimension.AskClaimMastery:InvokeServer(F.Id)
			end)
			task.wait(0.6)
		end
	end
end
t11.enter = function()
	local a = os.clock()

	while os.clock() - a < 6 do
		local a = genv.__SenaV4EggRuntime
		local W = genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal
		local d = (a and not a.destroyed and (a._snipeBusy or a.running or (a.carry and a.carry.active))) or (W and W.running) or t8.stealCarrying()

		if not d then
			break
		end

		t11.status = "Waiting for the current steal to finish"
		task.wait(0.2)
	end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") ~= true then
		t11.status = "Going to the Halloween dimension"

		local a = genv.__SenaV4TeleportNormalToHalloween

		if type(a) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end

		t11.allowTravel = true
		pcall(a, function()
			return t11.alive() and senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBoss == true and t11.open()
		end)
		t11.allowTravel = false

		local a = os.clock()

		repeat
			task.wait(0.2)
		until LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") == true or os.clock() - a > 6

		if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") ~= true then
			return false
		end
	end

	if genv.__SenaV4DimPark then
		pcall(genv.__SenaV4DimPark.restore)
	end

	local a = Workspace:WaitForChild("HalloweenDimension", 5)
	local S = a and a:FindFirstChild("BossPortal")
	local a = S and S:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")

	if not (a and a:IsA("BasePart")) then
		t11.status = "Boss portal not found"

		return false
	end

	t11.status = "Entering the boss portal"

	local S = os.clock()

	while t11.alive() and not t11.inArena() and os.clock() - S < 6 do
		local S = t11.root()

		if S then
			S.CFrame = a.CFrame
			S.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

			if firetouchinterest then
				pcall(firetouchinterest, S, a, 0)
				pcall(firetouchinterest, S, a, 1)
			end
		end

		RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
	end

	return t11.inArena()
end
genv.__SenaV4BossBusy = function()
	return t11.busy == true and not t11.allowTravel
end
t8.register("hw_boss", {
	enabled = function()
		return senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBoss == true
	end,
	wants = function()
		return senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBoss == true and (t11.inArena() or (t11.open() and t11.now() > (t11.doneUntil or 0)))
	end,
	active = function()
		return t11.busy == true
	end,
	status = function()
		return t11.status
	end
})
task.spawn(function()
	while t11.alive() do
		local a = senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBoss == true
		local _ = a or senaV4Config.HalloweenBossDodge == true

		if senaV4Config.HalloweenBossClaim == true and os.clock() >= t11.claimAt and not t11.inArena() then
			t11.claimAt = os.clock() + 20
			task.spawn(pcall, t11.claim)
		end

		if t11.inArena() and (a or _) and t11.mods() then
			t11.busy = a

			local s = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinArena")
			local S = s and s:GetAttribute("Phase")

			if S == "Defeated" then
				t11.status = "Boss down  ·  collecting drops"

				local S, s = pcall(function()
					return t11.S.ClosesAt(t11.now())
				end)

				t11.doneUntil = S and tonumber(s) or (t11.now() + 300)
				t11.defeatedAt = t11.defeatedAt or os.clock()

				if a then
					pcall(t11.collect)
				end

				local S = os.clock() - t11.defeatedAt

				if a and ((S > 3 and next(t11.drops) == nil) or S > 12) then
					t11.status = "Boss down  ·  heading back"
					pcall(t11.leave)
				end

				task.wait(0.3)
			else
				t11.defeatedAt = nil

				local S, s = pcall(t11.step, a, _)

				if not S then
					t11.status = "error: " .. tostring(s):sub(1, 80)
					task.wait(0.2)
				end

				RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
			end
		elseif a and t11.open() and t11.now() > (t11.doneUntil or 0) then
			local S = t8.blocker("hw_boss")
			local R = pcall(function()
				return t11.S.ClosesAt(t11.now())
			end)

			_ = R and _ or nil

			local function R()
				for s, s in ipairs({ "auto_steal", "hw_steal" }) do
					if t8.enabled(s) and (t8.wants(s) or t8.active(s)) then
						return s
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			if not S and _ and t11.graceWindow ~= _ and t11.secsLeft() > 85 and (t8.enabled("auto_steal") or t8.enabled("hw_steal")) then
				t11.graceWindow = _
				t11.busy = false

				local s = os.clock() + 10

				while os.clock() < s and t11.alive() and senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBoss == true do
					t11.status = string.format("Boss is up  ·  checking for eggs first (%ds)", math.max(1, math.ceil(s - os.clock())))

					if R() then
						t11.eggFirstWindow = _

						break
					end

					task.wait(0.25)
				end

				S = t8.blocker("hw_boss")
			end

			if not S and t11.eggFirstWindow == _ then
				S = R()
			end

			if S and S ~= "hw_boss" and t11.secsLeft() > 75 then
				t11.busy = false
				t11.status = "Waiting for " .. tostring(t8.TITLES[S] or S)
				task.wait(0.5)
			else
				t11.busy = true

				local S, F = pcall(t11.enter)

				if not (S and F) then
					if t11.status == "Entering the boss portal" then
						t11.status = "Portal did not take us, retrying"
					end

					t11.busy = false
					task.wait(1.5)
				end
			end
		else
			t11.busy = false

			if a then
				local a, S = pcall(function()
					return t11.S.NextOpensAt(t11.now())
				end)

				t11.status = a and type(S) == "number" and string.format("Next boss in %d:%02d", math.floor((S - t11.now()) / 60), math.floor((S - t11.now()) % 60)) or "Waiting for the boss"
			else
				t11.status = "Off"
			end

			table.clear(t11.hazards)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end

	t11.busy = false
end)

t12.walk = function(a, F, R, z)
	local L, _, s = os.clock() + (R or 15), nil, 0

	while t12.alive() and os.clock() < L do
		if z and z() then
			return true
		end

		local R, L = t12.root()

		if not (R and L) then
			return false
		end

		if Vector3.new(a.X - R.Position.X, 0, a.Z - R.Position.Z).Magnitude <= (F or 4) then
			return true
		end

		L:MoveTo(a)

		if _ and (R.Position - _).Magnitude < 0.5 then
			s += 1
		else
			s = 0
		end

		_ = R.Position

		if s > 8 then
			L.Jump = true
			s = 0
		end

		task.wait(0.15)
	end

	return z ~= nil and z() == true
end

t12.pet = function(a)
	local F = {}

	for R, R in ipairs(t12.peek().EquippedAssets or {}) do
		F[R] = true
	end

	return t12.tool(function(R)
		return R:GetAttribute("Category") == t12.PETS[a] and R:GetAttribute("Favorite") ~= true and not F[R:GetAttribute("UID")]
	end)
end
t12.shrine = function()
	local q, F = pcall(t12.MI.Interior)

	F = q and F or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ManorInterior")

	return F and F:FindFirstChild("FusionShrine", true)
end
t12.seat = function(a)
	local R

	for z, L in ipairs(t12.SEATS) do
		local _, s = false, false

		for W, W in pairs(L) do
			local d = a:FindFirstChild(W, true)
			local a = d and d:GetAttribute("PlacedUserId")

			if a == LocalPlayer.UserId then
				_ = true
			elseif a ~= nil then
				s = true
			end
		end

		if _ then
			return L, z
		end

		if not s and not R then
			R = z
		end
	end

	return R and t12.SEATS[R], R
end
t12.placed = function(a, F)
	local R = a:FindFirstChild(F, true)

	return R ~= nil and R:GetAttribute("PlacedUserId") == LocalPlayer.UserId
end
t12.voidReady = function()
	if not t12.unlocked() or t12.voidDone() then
		return false
	end

	local a = t12.shrine()
	local F = a and t12.seat(a)

	if not F then
		return false
	end

	for R, z in pairs(F) do
		if not t12.placed(a, z) and not t12.pet(R) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end
t12.voidMissing = function()
	local a = {}
	local F = t12.shrine()
	local R = F and t12.seat(F)

	for z, z in ipairs({ "Fish", "Pumpkin" }) do
		if not (R and t12.placed(F, R[z])) and not t12.pet(z) then
			local F = t12.tool(function(R)
				return R:GetAttribute("Category") == t12.PETS[z]
			end)
			local R = not F and t12.eggOwned and t12.eggOwned(t12.PETS[z])

			a[#a + 1] = t12.PETS[z] .. (F and (F:GetAttribute("Favorite") == true and " (unfavorite it)" or " (take it out of the pen)") or (R and " (hatch its egg)") or "")
		end
	end

	return a
end
t12.keyWanted = function()
	if senaV4Config.HalloweenManorKey ~= true or t12.unlocked() then
		return false
	end

	if t12.attr("InSewerCave") or t12.hasKey() then
		return true
	end

	local a = t12.train

	return type(a) == "table" and (a.Phase ~= "Home" or t12.boardable(a))
end
t12.pick = function()
	if not t12.mods() then
		return nil
	end

	if t12.keyWanted() then
		return "key"
	end

	if senaV4Config.HalloweenVoidFusion == true and (t12.attr("InManorInterior") or t12.voidReady()) and t12.unlocked() and not t12.voidDone() then
		return "void"
	end

	return nil
end
t12.urgent = function()
	if t12.attr("InSewerCave") or t12.attr("InManorInterior") then
		return true
	end

	local a = t12.train

	if type(a) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	if a.Phase ~= "Home" then
		return true
	end

	if not t12.boardable(a) then
		return false
	end

	return t12.departIn(a) < 25 or not t8.stealCarrying()
end
t12.fish = function()
	local a = t12.tool(function(F)
		return F:GetAttribute("GhostDogRod") == true
	end)

	if not a then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: needs the Haunted Rod (Fisherman Gilbert's quest)"
		task.wait(2)

		return
	end

	local F, R = t12.pos(t12.marker("Spawn")), t12.pos(t12.marker("Surface"))

	if not (F and R) then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: cave markers not found"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	t12.tp(F + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), R)

	if not t12.equip(a) then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: could not hold the Haunted Rod"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		t12.R.Fishing.Hold:FireServer()
	end)

	local a = os.clock()

	task.wait(1.05)

	local F = os.clock() - a
	local a, _, R = t12.root()

	if not a then
		return
	end

	local z, L = pcall(function()
		return t12.F.Probe(t12.F.Aim(a.Position, a.CFrame.LookVector, t12.F.ChargeAt(F)), { R })
	end)

	if not (z and type(L) == "table" and L.Water) then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: cast missed the water"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	local a = os.clock()
	local R, z = pcall(function()
		return t12.R.Fishing.Cast:InvokeServer(F, L.Point)
	end)

	if not R or type(z) ~= "table" or z.Id == nil then
		if t12.castId then
			pcall(function()
				t12.R.Fishing.Cancel:FireServer(t12.castId)
			end)
			t12.castId = nil
		end

		t12.status = "Manor Key: cast rejected, retrying"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	t12.castId = z.Id
	t12.status = "Manor Key: fishing for the key"

	if z.Mode == "Nothing" or z.Mode == "Hint" or z.Mode == "Quest" or z.Mode == "GhostFish" then
		pcall(function()
			t12.R.Fishing.Cancel:FireServer(z.Id)
		end)
		t12.castId = nil

		return
	end

	task.wait(math.max(0, a + (t12.F.FlightSeconds or 0.75) + (tonumber(z.Wait) or 0) + 0.6 - os.clock()))

	local a, F, R = pcall(function()
		return t12.R.Fishing.Reel:InvokeServer(z.Id, "Caught", 15)
	end)

	if a and F == true then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: caught " .. tostring(type(R) == "table" and (R.DisplayName or R.Kind or R.Id) or "something")
	else
		pcall(function()
			t12.R.Fishing.Cancel:FireServer(z.Id)
		end)
	end

	t12.castId = nil
end
t12.meetGus = function()
	if t12.manor().Met == true or t12.metGus then
		return true
	end

	local a = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ManorWorker")
	local S = a and a:FindFirstChild("TalkPrompt", true)
	local R = a and t12.pos(a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or a)

	if not (S and R) then
		return true
	end

	if not S.Enabled then
		t12.metGus = true

		return true
	end

	t12.status = "Manor Key: talking to Gus"
	t12.walk(R, 6, 8)
	t12.stopWalk()
	pcall(fireproximityprompt, S)
	task.wait(1)

	if not S.Enabled then
		t12.metGus = true
	end

	return t12.metGus == true
end
t12.keyStep = function()
	if t12.attr("InSewerCave") then
		if t12.hasKey() then
			t12.status = "Manor Key: got it, taking the pipe back"

			local a = t12.pos(t12.marker("Pipe"))

			if a then
				t12.walk(a, 3, 12, function()
					return not t12.attr("InSewerCave")
				end)
			end

			local a = os.clock()

			repeat
				task.wait(0.25)
			until not t12.attr("InSewerCave") or os.clock() - a > 8

			return
		end

		if not t12.meetGus() then
			task.wait(0.5)

			return
		end

		t12.fish()

		return
	end

	if t12.hasKey() then
		if not t12.toDim() then
			return
		end

		local a = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ManorDoorPrompt")
		local F = a and a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
		local R

		pcall(function()
			R = t12.pos(t12.MI.DoorOutside(t12.MI.Doors()))
		end)

		local z = t12.pos(a)

		if not (R or z) then
			t12.status = "Manor Key: manor door not found"
			task.wait(1)

			return
		end

		t12.status = "Manor Key: unlocking the manor door"
		t12.tp((R or z) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), z)
		task.wait(0.3)

		if F and F.Enabled then
			pcall(fireproximityprompt, F)
		else
			pcall(function()
				t12.R.ManorInterior.Request:InvokeServer()
			end)
		end

		task.wait(1.6)

		if t12.unlocked() then
			t12.status = "Manor unlocked"
		end

		return
	end

	local a = t12.trainStatus(true)

	if type(a) ~= "table" then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: train status unavailable"
		task.wait(2)

		return
	end

	if a.Phase == "Town" then
		local F = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged((t12.SC and t12.SC.WhirlpoolTag) or "SewerCaveWhirlpool")[1]
		local R = t12.pos(F)

		if not R then
			t12.status = "Manor Key: whirlpool not found"
			task.wait(1)

			return
		end

		t12.status = "Manor Key: walking into the Sewer Cave whirlpool"

		if not t12.walk(R, 3, 30, function()
			return t12.attr("InSewerCave")
		end) then
			return
		end

		t12.stopWalk()

		local F = os.clock()

		while t12.alive() and not t12.attr("InSewerCave") and os.clock() - F < 10 do
			local F = t12.root()

			if F and Vector3.new(R.X - F.Position.X, 0, R.Z - F.Position.Z).Magnitude > 6 then
				t12.walk(R, 3, 3)
				t12.stopWalk()
			end

			task.wait(0.2)
		end

		return
	end

	if a.Phase ~= "Home" then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: riding the Phantom Express (" .. tostring(a.Phase) .. ")"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	if not t12.boardable(a) then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: waiting for the Phantom Express"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	if a.AccessUnlocked ~= true and not t12.ticket() then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: needs the Train Pass (Gilbert's quest)"
		task.wait(3)

		return
	end

	if not t12.toDim() then
		return
	end

	if a.StationAvailable and not a.AtStation then
		t12.status = "Manor Key: going to the station"
		t12.action("Station")
		task.wait(2.5)
	end

	if a.AccessUnlocked ~= true then
		t12.equip(t12.ticket())
	end

	t12.status = "Manor Key: boarding the Phantom Express"
	t12.action("Board")
	task.wait(1)
	t12.trainStatus(true)
end
t12.voidStep = function()
	if not t12.attr("InManorInterior") then
		if not t12.toDim() then
			return
		end

		local a, F

		pcall(function()
			local R = t12.MI.Doors()

			F = t12.pos(t12.MI.DoorOutside(R))
			a = t12.pos(t12.MI.Doorway())
		end)

		if not (a and F) then
			t12.status = "Void Fusion: manor door not found"
			task.wait(1)

			return
		end

		t12.status = "Void Fusion: walking into the manor"
		t12.tp(F + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), a)
		task.wait(0.2)
		t12.walk(a, 2, 4, function()
			return t12.attr("InManorInterior")
		end)

		local F = os.clock()

		while t12.alive() and not t12.attr("InManorInterior") and os.clock() - F < 8 do
			t12.tp(a + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		return
	end

	local a = t12.shrine()
	local F, R

	if a then
		F, R = t12.seat(a)
	end

	if not F then
		t12.status = "Void Fusion: both seats taken, waiting"
		task.wait(1)

		return
	end

	local z = a:FindFirstChild("RitualCenter", true)

	for L, L in ipairs({ "Fish", "Pumpkin" }) do
		local _ = a:FindFirstChild(F[L], true)
		local s = _ and _:FindFirstChild("PlacePrompt", true)

		if _ and s and not t12.placed(a, F[L]) then
			local W = t12.pet(L)

			if not W then
				return
			end

			t12.status = string.format("Void Fusion: placing %s (seat %d)", t12.PETS[L], R)

			local d = t12.pos(_)
			local _ = z and Vector3.new(z.Position.X - d.X, 0, z.Position.Z - d.Z)
			local z = _ and _.Magnitude > 0.1 and _.Unit * 6 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)

			t12.tp(d + z + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), d)
			task.wait(0.3)

			if not t12.equip(W) then
				return
			end

			pcall(fireproximityprompt, s)

			local z = os.clock()

			repeat
				task.wait(0.1)
			until t12.placed(a, F[L]) or os.clock() - z > 2.5

			if not t12.placed(a, F[L]) then
				t12.status = "Void Fusion: the pad did not take the pet, retrying"
				task.wait(2)

				return
			end
		end
	end

	t12.status = a:GetAttribute("FusionPhase") == "Ritual" and "Void Fusion: ritual running" or string.format("Void Fusion: both pets placed (seat %d), waiting for a partner", R)
	task.wait(1)
end
t12.idleStatus = function()
	local a = {}

	if senaV4Config.HalloweenManorKey == true then
		a[#a + 1] = t12.unlocked() and "Manor unlocked" or "Manor Key: waiting for the Phantom Express (:00 / :30)"
	end

	if senaV4Config.HalloweenVoidFusion == true then
		if t12.voidDone() then
			a[#a + 1] = "Void Fusion done"
		elseif not t12.unlocked() then
			a[#a + 1] = "Void Fusion: unlock the manor first"
		else
			local F = genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt and genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt() or {}
			local S = t12.voidMissing()

			if F.pumpkin or F.fish then
				local R = {}

				if F.pumpkin then
					R[#R + 1] = F.pumpkin .. " (stealing its egg)"
				end

				if F.fish then
					R[#R + 1] = F.fish .. " (fishing)"
				end

				a[#a + 1] = "Void Fusion: hunting " .. table.concat(R, " + ")
			else
				a[#a + 1] = #S > 0 and ("Void Fusion: needs " .. table.concat(S, " + ")) or "Void Fusion: both seats taken, waiting"
			end
		end
	end

	return #a > 0 and table.concat(a, "  ·  ") or "Off"
end
genv.__SenaV4ManorBusy = function()
	return (t12.busy == true and not t12.allowTravel) or t12.attr("InSewerCave") or t12.attr("InManorInterior")
end
t12.hunt = {}
t12.huntAt = 0
t12.eggOwned = function(a)
	if t12.ER == nil then
		local R, z = pcall(function()
			return require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.EggRecords)
		end)

		t12.ER = R and z or false
	end

	for F, F in pairs(t12.peek().EggInventory or {}) do
		local R = type(F) == "table" and (F.AssetCategory or F.Category) or nil

		if not R and t12.ER then
			local z, L = pcall(t12.ER.Decode, F)

			R = z and type(L) == "table" and L.AssetCategory or nil
		end

		if R == a then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt = function()
	if os.clock() - t12.huntAt < 2 then
		return t12.hunt
	end

	t12.huntAt = os.clock()

	local q = {}

	if senaV4Config.HalloweenVoidFusion == true and t12.mods() and t12.unlocked() and not t12.voidDone() then
		local S = t12.shrine()
		local F = S and t12.seat(S)

		for R, R in ipairs({ "Fish", "Pumpkin" }) do
			local z = t12.PETS[R]
			local L = (F and t12.placed(S, F[R])) or t12.tool(function(S)
				return S:GetAttribute("Category") == z
			end) ~= nil or t12.eggOwned(z)

			if not L then
				q[R == "Fish" and "fish" or "pumpkin"] = z
			end
		end
	end

	t12.hunt = q

	return q
end
genv.__SenaV4HwStealOn = function()
	return senaV4Config.AutoStealHalloween == true or genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt().pumpkin ~= nil
end
genv.__SenaV4HwFishOn = function()
	return senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoFish == true or genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt().fish ~= nil
end
t8.register("hw_manor", {
	enabled = function()
		return senaV4Config.HalloweenManorKey == true or senaV4Config.HalloweenVoidFusion == true
	end,
	wants = function()
		return t12.pick() ~= nil
	end,
	active = function()

	end,

		return t12.status
	end
})
task.spawn(function()
	while t12.alive() do
		if not (senaV4Config.HalloweenManorKey == true or senaV4Config.HalloweenVoidFusion == true) or not t12.mods() then
			t12.busy = false
			t12.status = "Off"
			task.wait(1)
		else
			if senaV4Config.HalloweenManorKey == true and not t12.unlocked() and os.clock() - t12.trainAt > 3 then
				t12.trainStatus(true)
			end

			local a = t12.pick()

			if not a then
				t12.busy = false
				t12.status = t12.idleStatus()
				task.wait(1)
			else
				local F = t8.blocker("hw_manor")

				if F and F ~= "hw_manor" and not t12.urgent() then
					t12.busy = false
					t12.status = "Waiting for " .. tostring(t8.TITLES[F] or F)
					task.wait(0.5)
				else
					t12.busy = true

					local F, R = pcall(a == "key" and t12.keyStep or t12.voidStep)

					if not F then
						t12.status = "error: " .. tostring(R):sub(1, 80)
						task.wait(0.5)
					end

					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	t12.busy = false
end)

local __SenaV4DimPark = genv.__SenaV4DimPark

if __SenaV4DimPark and type(__SenaV4DimPark.stop) == "function" then
	pcall(__SenaV4DimPark.stop)
end

do
	local t13 = {
		HalloweenDimension = true,
		TrainEventAssets = true,
		TrainEventRuntime = true,
		TrainEventVisuals = true
	}
	local t14 = {
		parked = {},
		freeSince = nil,
		needed = function()
			if not senaV4Config or senaV4Config.StartupBoost ~= true or not v20() then
				return true
			end

			if genv.__SenaV4BossBusy and genv.__SenaV4BossBusy() then
				return true
			end

			if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InSewerCave") == true or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InManorInterior") == true then
				return true
			end

			if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") == true or genv.__SenaV4OnTrain == true then
				return true
			end

			if senaV4Config.HalloweenAutoBuy == true or senaV4Config.HalloweenTradeSouls == true or senaV4Config.HalloweenDogQuest == true then
				return true
			end

			local a = genv.__SenaV4EggCardsShown

			if type(a) == "function" then
				local F, z = pcall(a)

				if F and z then
					return true
				end
			end

			for a, a in ipairs(t8.order()) do
				if (a:sub(1, 3) == "hw_" or a == "phantom") and t8.enabled(a) then
					return true
				end
			end

			local a = LocalPlayer.Character
			local F = a and a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not F or F.Position.Y < -100.0 then
				return true
			end

			local a = v14()
			local S = a and a:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimensionPortal")
			local a = S and S:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true)

			if a and a:IsA("BasePart") then
				local S = a.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(F.Position)
				local F = a.Size * 0.5 + Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)

				if math.abs(S.X) < F.X and math.abs(S.Y) < F.Y and math.abs(S.Z) < F.Z then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		held = {}
	}

	t14.trainTable = function()
		if t14.trainTbl then
			return t14.trainTbl
		end

		if os.clock() < (t14.trainScanAt or 0) then
			return nil
		end

		t14.trainScanAt = os.clock() + 30

		local a = (debug and debug.getupvalues) or getupvalues

		if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(a) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end

		local F, R = pcall(getgc, false)

		if not F or type(R) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end

		for F, z in ipairs(R) do
			if F % 20000 == 0 and coroutine.isyieldable() then
				task.wait()
			end

			if type(z) == "function" then
				local F, R = pcall(debug.info, z, "s")

				if F and type(R) == "string" and R:find("Controllers.Game.TrainVisuals", 1, true) then
					local F, R = pcall(a, z)

					for a, a in pairs(F and R or {}) do
						if type(a) == "table" then
							local F, R = next(a)

							if typeof(F) == "Instance" and type(R) == "table" and rawget(R, "Cars") ~= nil and rawget(R, "Parts") ~= nil then
								t14.trainTbl = a

								return a
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end
	t14.holdTrains = function()
		local a = t14.trainTable()

		if not a then
			return
		end

		for F, R in pairs(a) do
			t14.held[F] = R
		end

		for F in pairs(t14.held) do
			a[F] = nil
		end
	end
	t14.releaseTrains = function()
		local a = t14.trainTbl

		if a then
			for F, R in pairs(t14.held) do
				if a[F] == nil and typeof(F) == "Instance" and F.Parent ~= nil then
					a[F] = R
				end
			end
		end

		table.clear(t14.held)
	end

				pcall(G, p)

				if p:IsA("Trail") then
					pcall(p.Destroy, p)
				end
			end
		end)

		local p = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if p then
			C.prevCam = p.CameraSubject
			p.CameraSubject = H
		end

		C.camConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if C.clone ~= O or not O.Parent then
				return
			end

			for p in pairs(x) do
				if p.Parent and p.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
					p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end

			local x = workspace.CurrentCamera

			if x and x.CameraSubject ~= H then
				x.CameraSubject = H
			end
		end)

		return true
	end
	local function x()
		if not C.clone then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local C = f()

			if C and I() and (r() or (C.Position - h).Magnitude > 1) then
				U(h, nil, not r())
			end
		end)
		g()
	end
	local function I(C)
		return (tostring(C):lower():gsub("%s+", ""))
	end

	local C = {}

	function B.defaultMode(p)
		return tonumber(p) == 1 and "Carry" or "Drop"
	end

	for p, p in pairs(B.profiles) do
		p.mode = p.confirmedMode or B.defaultMode(p.zone)
	end

	for p, G in pairs(T and T.Specs or {}) do
		if G.Group == "World" then
			local H = B.profiles[I(p)] or { claims = 0 }

			H.name, H.assetId, H.zone = p, p, G.Zone
			H.mode = H.confirmedMode or B.defaultMode(G.Zone)
			B.profiles[I(p)] = H

			for H, H in pairs({ p, G.DisplayName, G.Source, G.EggSource, G.EggModel }) do
				if type(H) == "string" then
					local G = I(H)

					if C[G] == nil then
						C[G] = p
					elseif C[G] ~= p then
						C[G] = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	do
		local p = {}

		for G, H in pairs(C) do
			if H then
				p[G] = true
			end
		end

		for G, H in pairs(T and T.Specs or {}) do
			if H.Group ~= "World" then
				for O, O in pairs({ G, H.DisplayName, H.Source, H.EggSource, H.EggModel }) do
					if type(O) == "string" then
						local H = I(O)

						if not p[H] then
							if C[H] == nil then
								C[H] = G
							elseif C[H] ~= G then
								C[H] = false
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function B.fallbackFor(p)
		if B.fallbackSpec == nil then
			B.fallbackSpec = false

			local G

			for H, O in pairs(type(T) == "table" and T.Specs or {}) do
				if type(O) == "table" and O.SharedEggFallback == true then
					if G then
						G = nil
						B.fallbackSpec = false

						break
					end

					G = { id = O.Id or H, zone = tonumber(O.Zone) }
				end
			end

			if G then
				B.fallbackSpec = G
			end
		end

		local T = B.fallbackSpec

		if T and (p == nil or T.zone == nil or T.zone == p) then
			return T.id
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function T(p)
		local G = p:GetAttribute("PreparedSourceName") or B.fallbackFor(tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Zone")))
		local H = G and (C[I(G)] or G)
		local G = H and I(H) or ("uid:" .. tostring(p:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") or p))
		local O = B.profiles[G]

		if not O then
			local K = tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Zone"))

			O = { name = H or "Unknown Egg", zone = K, mode = B.defaultMode(K), claims = 0 }
			B.profiles[G] = O
		end

		if not O.confirmedMode and O.mode == nil then
			O.mode = B.defaultMode(O.zone)
		end

		return O
	end
	local function p(G)
		local H = I(G)

		return C[H] or (B.profiles[H] and B.profiles[H].name) or G
	end
	local function G(H)
		local O = Q and Q.Directory and Q.Directory[p(H)]
		local H = O and O.Rarity

		if type(H) == "table" then
			return H.DisplayName or H._id or H.Name
		end

		return type(H) == "string" and H or nil
	end
	local function H(O)
		if not (O and O.Parent) then
			return false
		end

		local K = O:FindFirstChild("StealPrompt", true)

		if K then
			return K.Enabled
		end

		return O:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggCanPickUp") == true and type(O:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid")) == "string" and M.HalloweenDimension ~= nil and M.HalloweenDimension.AskCarryEgg ~= nil
	end

	function B.isHuntEgg(O)
		local K = genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt and genv.__SenaV4VoidHunt()

		return K ~= nil and K.pumpkin ~= nil and I(p(T(O).name)) == I(p(K.pumpkin))
	end

	local function O(K)
		local J = genv.SenaV4Config or {}

		if B.isHuntEgg(K) then
			return true
		end

		if B.indexWanted and B.indexWanted(K) then
			return true
		end

		local n = G(T(K).name)
		local l, i = {}, {}

		for b, b in ipairs(J.HalloweenNames or {}) do
			if b ~= "None" and b ~= "" then
				l[I(p(b))] = true
			end
		end

		for b, b in ipairs(J.HalloweenEggRarities or {}) do
			if b ~= "None" and b ~= "" then
				i[I(b)] = true
			end
		end

		if next(i) == nil then
			for b, b in ipairs(J.StealRarities or {}) do
				if b ~= "None" and b ~= "" then
					i[I(b)] = true
				end
			end
		end

		if (n == "Divine" or n == "Eternal") and (next(l) == nil or l.alleggs) and next(i) == nil then
			return true
		end

		local n = T(K).name
		local b = (next(l) == nil or l.alleggs or l[I(n)] == true) and (next(i) == nil or i.allrarities or i[I(G(n))] == true)
		local n = tonumber(J.HalloweenMinValue) or 0

		if b and n > 0 and B.eggValue then
			b = B.eggValue(K) >= n
		end

		return b
	end

	B.matchesEgg, B.eggName, B.eggRarity = O, function(K)
		return T(K).name
	end, G

	function B.wantsEgg(K)
		if (genv.SenaV4Config or {}).AutoStealHalloween == true then
			return O(K)
		end

		return B.isHuntEgg(K)
	end

	B.indexCache, B.indexAt, B.indexRecent = nil, 0, {}

	function B.indexMissing()
		if B.indexCache and os.clock() - B.indexAt < 5 then
			return B.indexCache
		end

		local K, J, n = {}, A(), {}

		for l, l in ipairs({ J.Inventory or {}, J.EggInventory or {} }) do
			for i, i in pairs(l) do
				local l = type(i) == "table" and (i.Category or i.AssetCategory)

				if l then
					n[l] = true
				end
			end
		end

		B.hwIndexData = B.hwIndexData or s("Data", "HalloweenIndex")

		local s, l = pcall(function()
			return B.hwIndexData.GetSections()
		end)

		if s and type(l) == "table" then
			for s, s in ipairs(l) do
				if s.Category == "HalloweenWorldEggs" then
					for l, l in ipairs(s.Entries or {}) do
						local s = l.AssetId

						if s and (J.Index or {})[s] ~= true and not n[s] and (B.indexRecent[I(s)] or 0) < os.clock() then
							K[I(s)] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		B.indexCache, B.indexAt = K, os.clock()

		return K
	end
	function B.indexWantedName(s)
		local K = genv.SenaV4Config or {}

		return K.HalloweenStealIndex == true and s ~= nil and B.indexMissing()[I(p(s))] == true
	end
	function B.indexWanted(s)
		return B.indexWantedName(T(s).name)
	end
	function B.eggPriority(s)
		local K = t15[G(s)] or 0

		K = K >= t15.Eternal and K or 0

		if K == 0 and B.indexWantedName(s) then
			return t15.Eternal - 0.5
		end

		return K
	end

	B.RARITY_HOLD = { Legendary = 1.1, Mythic = 1.2, Cosmic = 1.2, Secret = 1.2, Eternal = 1.3, Divine = 1.3 }

		return (L and B.RARITY_HOLD[G(L.name) or ""]) or 1
	end
	function B.carrySpeed()
		local L = genv.SenaV4Config or {}

		return math.clamp(tonumber(L.HalloweenCarrySpeed) or 290, 50, 340)
	end

	B.canPickUpEgg = H

	function B.returnForNight(L)
		if B.running then
			return false
		end

		B.running = true
		D, j = L, true
		B.status = "night reset: returning to Safe Zone"

		local L, s = pcall(U, h, function()
			return not Z()
		end)

		D, j = nil, false
		pcall(g)
		pcall(e)
		B.running = nil
		B.status = "night reset: waiting for daytime and open gates"

		return L and s == true
	end

	genv.__SenaV4HwStealState = B

	local function L(s, j)
		for G, G in ipairs(s:GetChildren()) do
			if G:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid") == j then
				return G
			end
		end

		return nil
	end
	local function s(j)
		local G = j:FindFirstChild("StealPrompt", true)

		if not H(j) then
			return false
		end

		local K = j:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid")
		local J = type(K) == "string" and M.HalloweenDimension and M.HalloweenDimension.AskCarryEgg or nil

		B.pickingUp = true

		local n, l = os.clock(), 0
		local i = B.adminBoostOn()
		local b, V = 0, 0

		repeat
			a()

			if J and os.clock() >= l and (not i or b < 3) then
				l = os.clock() + (i and 0 or (B.ASK_GAP or 0.15))

				if i then
					b += 1
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(J.InvokeServer, J, K)
						b -= 1
					end)
				else
					task.spawn(pcall, J.InvokeServer, J, K)
				end
			end

			if G and os.clock() >= V then
				V = os.clock() + 0.15
				pcall(fireproximityprompt, G)
			end

			local K = os.clock()

			repeat
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			until i or r() or os.clock() - K > 0.15
		until r() or not j.Parent or (G and not G.Parent) or os.clock() - n > 2 or (not H(j) and B.carrierOf(j) ~= nil)

		B.pickingUp = nil

		if r() then
			B.grabbedAt = os.clock()
		end

		return r()
	end

	genv.__SenaV4HwCrossSteal = function(j, G)
		local K = M.HalloweenDimension and M.HalloweenDimension.AskCarryEgg
		local J = j and j:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid")

		if not r() and (type(J) ~= "string" or not K or not H(j)) then
			return "refused"
		end

		local n = tonumber(_:GetAttribute("HalloweenDelivered")) or 0
		local l, i = _:GetAttribute("HalloweenLost"), _:GetAttribute("HalloweenSeized")

		local function b()
			return (tonumber(_:GetAttribute("HalloweenDelivered")) or 0) > n
		end
		local function n()
			return _:GetAttribute("HalloweenLost") ~= l or _:GetAttribute("HalloweenSeized") ~= i
		end
		local function l()
			return not v20() or (G and G())
		end

		local S, G = y()

		if not S then
			return "refused"
		end

		local y = "refused"
		local i, V = pcall(function()
			if not r() then
				B.status, B.pickingUp = "admin boost: grabbing " .. tostring(T(j).name), true

				local v, Y = os.clock() + 3, 0

				while not r() do
					if l() or os.clock() >= v or not j.Parent or _.Character ~= G or not S.Parent then
						return
					end

					if not H(j) and B.carrierOf(j) ~= nil then
						y = "lost"

						return
					end

					S.CFrame = CFrame.new(j:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * S.CFrame.Rotation
					m(S)

					if Y < 3 then
						Y += 1
						task.spawn(function()
							pcall(K.InvokeServer, K, J)
							Y -= 1
						end)
					end

					RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
				end

				B.pickingUp = nil
				B.grabbedAt = os.clock()
				B.carryUid, B.carryProfile, B.carrySpot = J, T(j), j.Parent and j:GetPivot().Position or nil
			end

			y = "held"
			B.status = "admin boost: straight to the Halloween Safe Zone"

			local j = os.clock() + 4

			while not b() do
				if n() or not r() then
					y = "lost"

					return
				end

				if l() or os.clock() >= j or _.Character ~= G or not S.Parent then
					return
				end

				S.CFrame = CFrame.new(h) * S.CFrame.Rotation
				m(S)
				RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
			end

			y = "delivered"
		end)

		B.pickingUp = nil
		pcall(e)

		if not i then
			B.status = "error: " .. tostring(V):sub(1, 120)
		end

		if y == "delivered" then
			B.carryUid, B.carryProfile, B.carrySpot = nil, nil, nil
			B.indexAt = 0
			genv.__SenaV4HwAdminMisses = 0
			B.status = "delivery confirmed"
		elseif y == "lost" then
			B.carryUid, B.carryProfile, B.carrySpot = nil, nil, nil
		elseif y == "held" then
			genv.__SenaV4HwAdminMisses = (genv.__SenaV4HwAdminMisses or 0) + 1
			B.status = genv.__SenaV4HwAdminMisses >= 2 and "admin boost (Halloween) missed twice - back to the normal route" or "admin boost: not delivered, retrying"
		end

		if y == "refused" and type(J) == "string" then
			B.bad[J] = os.clock() + 10
		end

		return y
	end

	function B.front(S, j)
		local y = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension")
		local G = y and y:FindFirstChild("Zones")
		local y = G and G:FindFirstChild("SafeZone")

		if not (y and y:IsA("BasePart")) then
			return false
		end

		local K = y.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(S)
		local S = G:FindFirstChild("Zone1")
		local G = ((S and S:IsA("BasePart") and y.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(S.Position).Z < 0) and -K.Z or K.Z) - y.Size.Z / 2

		return G > (j or -4.0) and G < (B.SNIPE_DEPTH or 45) and math.abs(K.X) < y.Size.X / 2 + 15
	end
	function B.carrierOf(S)
		local j = S:GetPivot().Position
		local S, y = nil, 20

		for G, G in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local R = G ~= _ and G:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") == true and G.Character
			local K = R and R:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local R = K and (K.Position - j).Magnitude

			if R and R < y then
				S, y = G, R
			end
		end

		return S
	end
	function B.outsideSafe(S)
		local R = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension")
		local j = R and R:FindFirstChild("Zones")
		local R = j and j:FindFirstChild("SafeZone")

		if not (R and R:IsA("BasePart")) then
			return false
		end

		local j = R.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(S)

		return math.abs(j.X) > R.Size.X / 2 + 2 or math.abs(j.Z) > R.Size.Z / 2 + 2
	end
	function B.huntWho(S)
		if workspace:GetAttribute("PvPDisabled") or H(S) then
			return nil
		end

		local R = B.carrierOf(S)
		local S = R and R.Character and R.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local j = genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal

		if R and (genv.SenaV4Config or {}).SkipFriends ~= false and j and j.isFriend and j.isFriend(R) then
			return nil
		end

		return S and B.outsideSafe(S.Position) and R or nil
	end
	function B.isBat(S)
		return genv.__SenaV4Bats.isBat(S)
	end

	B.HUNT_LEADS = B.HUNT_LEADS or { 1, 0.75, 1.25, 0.5, 1.5 }
	B.huntGrab = function(S, R)
		local j = S:GetAttribute("HalloweenEggUid")
		local S = M.HalloweenDimension and M.HalloweenDimension.AskCarryEgg
		local y = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenDimension")
		local G = y and y:FindFirstChild("WorldEggs")

		if type(j) ~= "string" or not S or not G then
			return false
		end

		local _, y, K = f()

		local function J()
			local n = K:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

			if n and B.isBat(n) then
				return n
			end

			return genv.__SenaV4Bats.best(K, _:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
		end

		local n = J()

		if n and y and n.Parent ~= K then
			pcall(y.EquipTool, y, n)
		end

		local l = B.HUNT_LEADS
		local i = math.clamp(_:GetNetworkPing(), 0.03, 0.6)
		local b = math.clamp(i + 0.105, 0.1, 0.8)

		B.leadIdx = B.hitIdx or B.leadIdx or 1

		local V, v = R:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false, R:GetAttribute("HalloweenKnocked")
		local Y = nil
		local c, E = {}, Vector3.zero
		local X, N = 0, 0
		local P, t, v1267, n6 = nil, nil, nil, 0
		local S7, F7, R7, n7 = os.clock(), 0, 0, 0

		B.pickingUp = true

		while not r() and os.clock() - S7 < (B.HUNT_SECS or 6) do
			a()

			local S7 = os.clock()
			local L7 = Y ~= nil and S7 - Y < 1

			if S7 >= F7 then
				F7 = S7 + (L7 and 0.05 or (B.HUNT_ASK_GAP or 0.1))
				task.spawn(pcall, S.InvokeServer, S, j)
			end

			local S = L(G, j)

			if not S then
				P = P or S7

				if S7 - P > 0.5 then
					break
				end

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

				continue
			end

			P = nil

			local j = H(S)
			local G = R.Character and R.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not j and (not G or R:GetAttribute("HalloweenCarrying") ~= true or not B.outsideSafe(G.Position)) then
				break
			end

			local P = f()

			if not P then
				break
			end

			if j then
				P.CFrame = CFrame.new(S:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * P.CFrame.Rotation
				m(P)
			else
				c[#c + 1] = { t = S7, p = G.Position }

				while #c > 2 and S7 - c[1].t > 0.25 do
					table.remove(c, 1)
				end

				local S = G.AssemblyLinearVelocity

				if Vector3.new(S.X, 0, S.Z).Magnitude > 8 then
					E = S
				elseif #c >= 2 and S7 - c[1].t > 0.1 then
					E = (G.Position - c[1].p) / (S7 - c[1].t)
				end

				local S = Vector3.new(E.X, 0, E.Z)
				local m = S.Magnitude
				local F7 = c[#c - 1]

				if (F7 and (G.Position - F7.p).Magnitude < 0.3) or m > (B.HUNT_MAX_TWEEN or 900) then
					m = 0
				end

				local c

				if m > 6 then
					c = S.Unit
				else
					local S = G.CFrame.LookVector

					S = Vector3.new(S.X, 0, S.Z)
					c = S.Magnitude > 0.05 and S.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
				end

				local S = L7 and (G.Position + c * 1.5) or (G.Position + c * math.clamp((l[B.leadIdx] or 1) * math.min(m, 600) * b, 3, 250))

				X, N = m, (S - G.Position).Magnitude

				local m = Vector3.new(G.Position.X, S.Y, G.Position.Z)

				if (m - S).Magnitude < 0.5 then
					m = S - c
				end

				P.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(S, m)
				P.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(E.X, 0, E.Z)
				P.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				t = t or S7
			end

			local S, m = R:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false, R:GetAttribute("HalloweenKnocked")

			if S ~= V or m ~= v then
				V, v, B.hitIdx, n6, v1267, Y = S, m, B.leadIdx, 0, nil, S7
				B.knocks = (B.knocks or 0) + 1

				if B.huntLog and #B.huntLog < 300 then
					B.huntLog[#B.huntLog + 1] = string.format("%.2f KNOCK %s idx=%d", S7, R.Name, B.leadIdx)
				end
			end

			if (not n or n.Parent ~= K) and S7 >= n7 then
				n7 = S7 + 0.5
				n = J()

				if n and y and n.Parent ~= K then
					pcall(y.EquipTool, y, n)
				end
			end

			local S = n and tonumber(n:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0

			if v1267 and S7 - v1267 > i + 0.45 then
				n6 = n6 + 1

				if n6 >= 2 then
					n6, B.leadIdx = 0, (B.leadIdx % #l) + 1
				end

				v1267 = nil
			end

			if not j and n and n.Parent == K and t and S7 - t >= math.clamp(i * 0.5 + 0.05, 0.08, 0.35) and not workspace:GetAttribute("PvPDisabled") and n:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") ~= true and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= S and S7 - R7 >= 0.35 then
				R7 = S7

				if not v1267 then
					v1267 = S7
				end

				genv.__SenaBatSeq = (genv.__SenaBatSeq or 0) + 1
				B.swings = (B.swings or 0) + 1

				if B.huntLog and #B.huntLog < 300 then

		end

		if t28.world ~= s then
			if t28.world ~= nil then
				t28.since = S
			end

		end

		local R = a

			t28.dryAt = 0

			return s
		end

		if R == nil or R == s then
			t28.dryAt = 0

			return R
		end

		if not v1892() then
			t28.dryAt = 0

			return R
		end

		end

							end
						end

						return
					end

					if S == "hw_fish" then
						halloween.fishStep(a)

						return
					end

					a.stats.noegg = a.stats.noegg + 1

					do
						local S, R = genv.__SenaV4HwStealState, os.clock() + 0.4

						repeat
							task.wait(0.05)
						until os.clock() >= R or (S and S.snipeTarget and S.snipeTarget() ~= nil)
					end
				end)

				halloween.releaseMobBat(a)
				a.stats.cur, a.busy = nil, nil

				if not F then
					a.stats.fails = a.stats.fails + 1
					a.stats.lastErr = tostring(g)
					task.wait(0.5)
				end

				task.wait(0.05)
			end

			halloween.releaseMobBat(a)
		end)
	end
end

halloween.refresh = function()
	if not genv.__SenaV4HwFishOn() and senaV4Config.HalloweenDogQuest ~= true then
		halloween.cancelFishing()
	end

	if senaV4Config.HalloweenHitMobs ~= true then
		halloween.releaseMobBat(genv.__SenaHalloweenFarm)
	end

	local a = genv.__SenaV4HwStealOn() or (senaV4Config.HalloweenHitMobs == true) or (senaV4Config.HalloweenCollectPumpkin == true) or genv.__SenaV4HwFishOn() or (senaV4Config.HalloweenDogQuest == true) or (next(genv.__SenaV4HwManual or {}) ~= nil)

	if a then
		if not (genv.__SenaHalloweenFarm and genv.__SenaHalloweenFarm.running) then
			halloween.start()
		end
	else
		halloween.stop()
	end
end
halloween.setEnabled = function(a)
	halloween.refresh()
end

		end

		function F7:_knockbackLanded()
			local _, C, v = v8()

			if not C or not v then
				return false
			end

			if v.PlatformStand or v.Sit then
				return true
			end

			local P = v:GetState()

			if P == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or P == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or P == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
				return true
			end

			return C.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 18
		end

		F7._settleAfterKnockback = function(C)
			local v = C.guardStrikeAnchor
			local P = os.clock() + 0.35

			while os.clock() < P and not C.destroyed do
				local P = LocalPlayer.Character
				local R7 = P and P:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if not R7 then
					return
				end

				local _7 = P:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if _7 then
					pcall(function()
						_7.PlatformStand = false
						_7.Sit = false
						_7:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
					end)
				end

				if v then
					R7.CFrame = CFrame.new(v)
				end

				R7.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				R7.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				C:_syncHoverPad(v or R7.Position)
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end

		function F7:_startGuardStrike()
			self:_stopGuardStrike()

			local C = self.guardStrikeGeneration

			task.spawn(function()
				local v = os.clock() + 1.5

				while not self.destroyed and self.enabled and self.instantPhase == "priming" and self.guardStrikeGeneration == C and os.clock() < v do
					self:_triggerGuardHit()

					local v = os.clock() + 0.05
					local P = false

					while os.clock() < v do
						if self:_knockbackLanded() then
							P = true

							break
						end

						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					if P then
						break
					end
				end

				if self.guardStrikeGeneration == C then
					self:_stopGuardStick()
					self:_settleAfterKnockback()
				end
			end)
		end
		function F7:_enterBaitWait()
			self:_setInstantAnchored(false)
			self:_setStatus("Preparing steal")
			self:_startGuardStick()
			self:_startGuardStrike()

			if self.hitTimer then
				return
			end

			self.hitTimer = task.delay(1.8, function()
				self.hitTimer = nil

				if self.destroyed or not self.enabled then
					return
				end

				if self.instantPhase ~= "priming" then
					return
				end

				self:_stopGuardStick()
				self:_stopGuardStrike()

				if self.carry.active and self:_isPrimerEgg(self.carry.uid) then
					pcall(a.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
				end

				self:_finish("Steal timed out — retrying")
			end)
		end

		local function C(v, P)
			local R7 = tostring(v or ""):lower()
			local v, _7 = 8, 3.5

			if R7:find("enchanted") then
				v, _7 = 18, 12
			elseif R7:find("light") or R7:find("dark") then
				v, _7 = 16, 10
			elseif R7:find("titan") or R7:find("cosmic") or R7:find("cherry") then
				v, _7 = 10, 8
			end

			return math.max(_7, v * ((11 - math.clamp(P, 1, 10)) / 6))
		end

		function F7:_resolveSettleSeconds(v)
			local P = math.clamp(tonumber(senaV4Config.StealHoldSeconds) or 5, 1, 10)
			local R7 = self.settleBonus and type(v) == "table" and self.settleBonus[v.Uid]
			local _7 = (R7 and R7.untilAt > os.clock()) and R7.seconds or 0
			local R7 = v63()

			if R7 > 0 and R7 < 12 then

						end

			end

			end

			end)

		function F7:requestCarryRecovery(v)
			if self.destroyed or not self.enabled or type(v) ~= "string" or v == "" then
				return false
			end

			if self:isSkippedEgg(v) then
				return true
			end

			if self.tweenRecoveryUid == v then
				self:_scheduleMovementRetry()

				return true
			end

			if self.carry.active and self.carry.uid == v then
				return true
			end

			local P = a.ReadFieldEgg(v) or self.records[v]

			if type(P) ~= "table" or (P.State ~= l.States.Dropped and P.State ~= l.States.Slot) then
				return false
			end

			local S7 = self.carryWorker

			if (S7 and S7.kind == "re-steal" and S7.uid == v) or (self.activeTween and self.activeTarget and self.activeTarget.Uid == v) or (self.carryAttemptToken and self.activeTarget and self.activeTarget.Uid == v) then
				return true
			end

			self.carry.generation += 1
			self:_invalidateCarryWorker()
			self.carryAttemptToken = nil
			self.running = true
			self.activeTarget = P
			task.defer(function()
				if not self.destroyed and self.enabled and not self.carry.active then
					self:_reStealDroppedEgg(v)
				end
			end)

			return true
		end

		function F7:_adoptCarryFromRecord(v)

				return
			end

			if self.carryTimeouts then

			end

			if self.instantPhase == "priming" and v == self.primerUid then
				self.carry.active = true
				self.carry.uid = v

				return
			end

			self.carry.generation += 1
			self:_invalidateCarryWorker()
			self:_clearArrivalHold(v)

			local P = self.activeTarget

			self.claimPresentationSuppression = { assetCategory = P and P.AssetCategory, expiresAt = os.clock() + 8 }
			self.carry.active = true
			self.carry.uid = v
			self.carryStartTime = os.clock()

			local S7 = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			self.carryStartPos = (P and P.BottomCFrame and P.BottomCFrame.Position) or (S7 and S7.Position)

			if self.tweenRecoveryUid == v then
				self.tweenRecoveryUid = nil
			end

			self.stats.lastResult = "Carry confirmed"
			self:_notify()
		end

		function F7:travelAndWait(S, d)
			d = d or {}

			if self.destroyed then
				return false
			end

			if self.travelBusy and os.clock() < (self.travelBusyUntil or 0) then
				return false
			end

			if self.activeTween and not self.running and (not self.activeTween.sharedTravel or d.preempt == true) then
				pcall(self.activeTween.Cancel, self.activeTween)

				local M = os.clock() + 0.5

				while self.activeTween and os.clock() < M do
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
			end

			if self.activeTween then
				return false
			end

			local M = LocalPlayer.Character
			local w = M and M:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not w then
				return false
			end

			self.travelBusy = true
			self.travelBusyUntil = os.clock() + 45

			local M, A = pcall(function()
				local m = nil
				local p = os.clock()
				local v = p
				local P = (S.Position - w.Position).Magnitude
				local w = math.max(tonumber(d.speed) or self.config.speed or DEF_SPEED, MIN_SPEED)
				local W = p + P / w + 6

				self.travelBusyUntil = W + 2
				self:_tweenRoot(S, nil, d.speed, { silent = true, sharedTravel = true, abort = function()
					return self.destroyed or (d.abort ~= nil and d.abort())
				end, onDone = function(w)
					m = w == true
				end })

				while m == nil do
					local w = os.clock()
					local p = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local S7 = p and (S.Position - p.Position).Magnitude or math.huge

					if S7 < P - 0.5 then
						P = S7
						v = w
					end

					local S = self.destroyed or (d.abort ~= nil and d.abort())
					local d = w - v >= 1.5

					if S or d or w >= W then
						if self.activeTween and self.activeTween.Cancel then
							pcall(self.activeTween.Cancel)
						end

						m = false

						break
					end

					task.wait(0.05)
				end

				return m
			end)

			self.travelBusy = false

			if not M then
				if self.activeTween and self.activeTween.sharedTravel and self.activeTween.Cancel then
					pcall(self.activeTween.Cancel)
				end

				return false
			end

			return A == true
		end
