						if self:_isBat(s) then
							return s, false
						end
					end
				end

				if L == 1 then
					pcall(function()
						local L = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages") and ReplicatedStorage.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
						local s = L and L:FindFirstChild("RF/Codex/AskWearFieldBat")

						if s then
							s:InvokeServer()
						end
					end)
				end
			end

			return nil, false
		end
		function _:_equipBat(L)
			local s = LocalPlayer.Character
			local W = s and s:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if not W or W.Health <= 0 then
				return nil
			end

			local d, M = self:_findBat()

			if not d then
				return nil
			end

			if L then
				L.bat = d

				if self.defendThread ~= L or not self.active or not self.enabled or LocalPlayer.Character ~= L.character then
					self:_releaseBat(L)

					return nil
				end
			end

			if M and d.Parent == s then
				return d
			end

			pcall(W.EquipTool, W, d)

			local L = os.clock() + 0.35

			while os.clock() < L do
				if d.Parent == s then
					return d
				end

				task.wait(0.05)
			end

			return d.Parent == s and d or nil
		end
		function _:_releaseBat(L)
			if not L or not L.bat then
				return
			end

			local s = L.bat

			L.bat = nil

			local W, d = genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal, genv.__SenaHalloweenFarm

			if (W and W.running) or (d and d.mobBat == s) or (self.defendThread and self.defendThread ~= L and self.defendThread.bat == s) then
				return
			end

			local W = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

			if W and LocalPlayer.Character == L.character and s.Parent == L.character then
				pcall(function()
					s.Parent = W
				end)
			end
		end
		function _:_getNearbyEnemies()
			local L = LocalPlayer.Character
			local s = L and L:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not s then
				return {}
			end

			local L = {}

			for W, W in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if W ~= LocalPlayer and W.Character then
					local F = W.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local d = W.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if F and d and d.Health > 0 then
						local M = (F.Position - s.Position).Magnitude

						if M <= self.targetRange then
							table.insert(L, { player = W, root = F, humanoid = d, distance = M })
						end
					end
				end
			end

			table.sort(L, function(F, s)
				return F.distance < s.distance
			end)

			return L
		end
		function _:_swing(F, L)
			if not F or F.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
				return false
			end

			local s = self.defendThread
			local W = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

			if W - self.lastSwingAt < 0.22 then
				return false
			end

			self.lastSwingAt = W
			pcall(F.Activate, F)

			local d = F:FindFirstChild("Handle") or F:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

			if d and L and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					firetouchinterest(d, L, 0)
					task.wait(0.01)
					firetouchinterest(d, L, 1)
				end)
			end

			if self.defendThread ~= s or not self.active or not self.enabled or F.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
				return false
			end

			pcall(function()
				local F = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
				local L = F.BatSwing

				if L and L.Trigger then
					self.swingSequence = self.swingSequence + 1

					local F = string.format("%d:%d:%d", LocalPlayer.UserId, self.swingSequence, math.floor(W * 1000))

					L.Trigger:FireServer(nil, F)
				end
			end)

			return true
		end
		function _:startDefend(F)
			if not self.enabled then
				return
			end

			if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") == true or genv.__SenaV4OnTrain == true then
				return
			end

			if self.eggRuntime and self.eggRuntime.instantPhase == "priming" then
				return
			end

			if F and self.eggRuntime and self.eggRuntime:isSkippedEgg(F) then
				return
			end

			local L = genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal

			if L and L.running then
				return
			end

			self.active = true
			self.activeDroppedUid = F

			if self.defendThread then
				return
			end

			local F = { character = LocalPlayer.Character }

			self.defendThread = F
			task.spawn(function()
				local L, s = pcall(function()
					while self.defendThread == F and self.active and self.enabled and v20() do
						local a = LocalPlayer.Character
						local W = a and a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

						if a ~= F.character or not W or W.Health <= 0 then
							break
						end

						if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InHalloweenDimension") == true or genv.__SenaV4OnTrain == true then
							break
						end

						if self.eggRuntime and (self.eggRuntime.destroyed or self.eggRuntime.instantPhase == "priming" or (self.eggRuntime.carry and self.eggRuntime.carry.active)) then
							break
						end

						local a = genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal

						if a and a.running then
							break
						end

						local a = self.activeDroppedUid

						if a then
							if F.uid ~= a then
								F.uid, F.seen, F.missingUntil = a, false, os.clock() + 5
							end

							if self.eggRuntime and self.eggRuntime:isSkippedEgg(a) then
								break
							end

							local z = q.ReadFieldEgg(a)

							if z then
								if z.CarrierUserId or (z.State ~= "Dropped" and z.State ~= "Slot") then
									break
								end

								F.seen = true
							elseif F.seen or os.clock() >= F.missingUntil then
								break
							end
						end

						local q = self:_getNearbyEnemies()

						if #q == 0 then
							break
						end

						if #q > 0 then
							local a = self:_equipBat(F)

							if a then
								for z, z in ipairs(q) do
									if self.defendThread ~= F or not self.active or not self.enabled or (self.eggRuntime and self.eggRuntime.carry and self.eggRuntime.carry.active) or (genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal and genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal.running) then
										break
									end

									if z.root and z.root.Parent then
										self:_swing(a, z.root)
									end
								end
							end
						end

						task.wait(0.1)
					end
				end)

				if self.defendThread == F then
					self.active, self.activeDroppedUid, self.defendThread = false, nil, nil
				end

				self:_releaseBat(F)

				if not L then
					warn("[Sena God Mode] defense stopped: " .. tostring(s))
				end
			end)
		end
		function _:stopDefend()
			local q = self.defendThread

			self.active = false
			self.activeDroppedUid = nil
			self.defendThread = nil
			self:_releaseBat(q)
		end
		function _:setEnabled(q)
			self.enabled = q == true

			if not self.enabled then
				self:stopDefend()
			end
		end
		function _:_bindSignals()
			pcall(function()
				local q = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.EggState)

				table.insert(self.connections, q.CarryChanged:Connect(function(q)
					if q.IsCarrying then
						self:stopDefend()
					else
						if self.enabled then
							self:startDefend(q.Uid)
						end
					end
				end))
			end)
			pcall(function()
				local q = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
				local a = q.GuardPatrol and q.GuardPatrol.ForestStrike

				if a then
					table.insert(self.connections, a.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
						if self.enabled then
							self:startDefend()
						end
					end))
				end
			end)
		end
		function _:destroy()
			self:stopDefend()

			for q, q in ipairs(self.connections) do
				pcall(q.Disconnect, q)
			end

			table.clear(self.connections)
		end

		return _
	end)()
	local v3839 = (function()

			pcall(Q, self:_snapshot())

			return function()
				local T = table.find(self.listeners, Q)

				if T then
					table.remove(self.listeners, T)
				end
			end

		function L:_shouldBlockTreadmill()

			end

			if self.busy and self.config.disableDuringAutomation then
				return true
			end

					local Q, T = self:_requestUnequip()

					self:_setStatus("Automation active", Q and "Blocked" or ("Release retry: " .. tostring(T)))
					task.wait(F)
					F = math.min(F * 2, 0.75)
				end

				self.unequipGuardRunning = false

				if self:_shouldBlockTreadmill() and self.activeTreadmill ~= nil then
					self:_startUnequipGuard()
				end
			end)
		end
		function L:_cancelIdle(F)
			self.idleGeneration += 1

			if F then
				self:_requestUnequip()
			end
		end
		function L:setDisableDuringAutomation(F)
			self.config.disableDuringAutomation = true

			if self.busy and self.config.disableDuringAutomation then
				self:_cancelIdle(true)

			elseif not self.busy and self.config.idleFarm then

			end
		end

			end)

		function L:_readUpgradeState()
			local F, Q, T, x = pcall(function()
				local h = (s.Peek or s.Get)()

				if not h then
					return nil
				end

				local s = tonumber(h.TreadmillUpgradeLevel) or 0

				return s, h.Money, W.GetByUpgradeLevel(s + 1)
			end)

			if not F or Q == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return Q, T, x
		end
		function L:_raiseTier()
			local _, F, s = self:_readUpgradeState()

			if not s then
				return false, "Max tier"
			end

			if (tonumber(F) or 0) < (tonumber(s.Price) or 0) then
				return false, "Not enough money"
			end

			local F, W, Q = pcall(function()
				return a.Treadmill.AskTierRaise:InvokeServer(s._id)
			end)

			if not F then
				return false, tostring(W)
			end

			if W ~= true then
				return false, tostring(Q or "Server rejected")
			end

			return true, s.DisplayName or s._id
		end
		function L:setAutoUpgrade(F)
			self.config.autoUpgrade = F == true

			if not self.config.autoUpgrade or self.autoUpgradeRunning then
				return
			end

			self.autoUpgradeRunning = true
			task.spawn(function()

					local F, s = self:_raiseTier()

					if F then
						self:_setStatus(self.busy and "Automation active" or "Idle", "Upgraded to " .. tostring(s))
						task.wait(1)
					elseif s == "Max tier" then
						self:_setStatus(self.busy and "Automation active" or "Idle", "Treadmill maxed")
						task.wait(30)
					else
						task.wait(5)
					end
				end

				self.autoUpgradeRunning = false
			end)
		end
		function L:_resolveStandCFrame()

			end

			local F = _.ResolveLocalSlot()

		function L:isEngaged()

							task.wait(2)

							end

						end

								end

							end

								self:_requestUnequip()
								self:_setStatus("Idle", I())

								break
							end

							task.wait(0.25)
						end
					end
				end, debug.traceback)

				if not s then
					warn("[SAE][treadmill] idle error:\n" .. tostring(W))
				end

				if self.idleRunning == F then
					self.idleRunning = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		function L:_onCoordinator(F)
			local R = self.busy

			self.busy = F.busy == true

			if self.busy then
				self:_cancelIdle(self.config.disableDuringAutomation)
				self:_startUnequipGuard()
				self:_setStatus("Automation active", self.config.disableDuringAutomation and "Blocked" or "Unchanged")
			elseif R or self.config.idleFarm then
				if self.config.idleFarm then
					self:_startIdle()
				else
					self:_setStatus("Idle", "Disabled")
				end
			end
		end
		function L:_listenCoordinator()
			if not self.coordinator then
				return
			end

			table.insert(self.resources, self.coordinator:subscribe(function(F)
				self:_onCoordinator(F)
			end))
			table.insert(self.resources, self.coordinator:subscribeBackground(function(F)
				if F.busy then
					self:_cancelIdle(false)
					self:_setStatus("Idle", "Waiting for background inventory")
				elseif not self.destroyed and not self.busy and self.config.idleFarm then
					self:_startIdle()
				end
			end))
		end
		function L:_syncActiveTreadmillSnapshot()
			local F, R = pcall(function()
				return a.Treadmill.AskRenderSnapshot:InvokeServer()
			end)

			if not F or type(R) ~= "table" then
				return self.activeTreadmill ~= nil
			end

			local F = table.find(R, LocalPlayer.UserId) ~= nil

			self.activeTreadmill = F and "snapshot" or nil

			if not F then
				self.treadmillEquipPending = false
			end

			return F
		end
		function L:_listenActiveTreadmill()
			local function F(R)
				self.treadmillStateRevision += 1
				self.activeTreadmill = R
				self.treadmillEquipPending = false

				if R ~= nil and self:_shouldBlockTreadmill() then
					self:_startUnequipGuard()
				elseif R == nil and self:_shouldBlockTreadmill() then
					self:_setStatus("Automation active", "Blocked")
				elseif R == nil then
					self:_setStatus("Idle", self.config.idleFarm and "Released" or "Disabled")
				elseif not self.busy then
					self:_setStatus("Active", "Waiting for gain")
				end
			end

			local R, z = nil, nil

			pcall(function()
				R = a.Treadmill.AssignedBeltShifted
			end)
			pcall(function()
				z = a.Treadmill.RenderStateShifted
			end)

			if R then
				table.insert(self.resources, R.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(R)
					F(R)
				end))

				return
			end

			if z then
				table.insert(self.resources, z.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(R, z)
					if R ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
						return
					end

					F(z and R or nil)
				end))
			end
		end
		function L:_listenSpeedGain()
			local S = a.Treadmill.SpeedGained

			if S then
				table.insert(self.resources, S.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
					self.activeTreadmill = self.activeTreadmill or true
					self.treadmillEquipPending = false

					if self:_shouldBlockTreadmill() then
						self:_startUnequipGuard()

						return
					end

					self:_setStatus("Active", "Gain ticking")
				end))
			end
		end
		function L:destroy()
			if self.destroyed then
				return
			end

			self.destroyed = true
			self:_cancelIdle(true)

			for a, a in ipairs(self.resources) do
				pcall(function()
					if typeof(a) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
						a:Disconnect()
					elseif type(a) == "function" then
						a()
					elseif type(a) == "table" and type(a.Disconnect) == "function" then
						a:Disconnect()
					end
				end)
			end

			table.clear(self.resources)
			table.clear(self.listeners)
		end

		L.Destroy = L.destroy

		return L
	end)()

		local Q = { cache = {}, crc = nil, size = 96 }

		function Q.crc32(k)
			if not Q.crc then
				Q.crc = {}

				for B = 0, 255 do
					local D = B

					for j = 1, 8 do
						D = bit32.band(D, 1) == 1 and bit32.bxor(3988292384, bit32.rshift(D, 1)) or bit32.rshift(D, 1)
					end

				end
			end

			for D = 1, #k do
				B = bit32.bxor(Q.crc[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(B, k:byte(D)), 255)], bit32.rshift(B, 8))
			end

			end

			return "\137PNG\r\n\26\n" .. Q.chunk("IHDR", string.pack(">I4>I4", k, B) .. "\8\6\0\0\0") .. Q.chunk("IDAT", table.concat(U)) .. Q.chunk("IEND", "")

						y = string.format("<font color=\"#%s\">%s</font>  <font color=\"#A2A2AE\">[%s]</font>", w(o.rarityColor), tostring(o.name or "Egg"), tostring(o.rarity or "Common"))
						u = string.format("Running in %s%s", r, A and ("  -  " .. A .. " studs") or "")
					else
						y = "No Egg Carried"
						u = string.format("Idle in %s%s", r, A and ("  -  " .. A .. " studs") or "")
					end

					f[#f + 1] = { id = tostring(m.UserId), name = tostring(m.DisplayName or m.Name), sub = string.format("<font color=\"#4ADE80\">@%s</font>  <font color=\"#A2A2AE\">[%s]</font>", tostring(m.Name), r), status = y, statusSub = u, button = "Steal", buttonColor = e and "accent" or "dim", player = m, carrying = e ~= nil, rank = C or -1.0, distance = A or 1e9, onClick = function(w, A)
						local r = self:strike(w.player)

						A(r and "Chasing" or "No Egg", r and "green" or "red")
						task.delay(1.6, function()
							pcall(A, "Steal", w.carrying and "accent" or "dim")
						end)
					end }
				end
			end

			table.sort(f, function(w, A)
				if w.carrying ~= A.carrying then
					return w.carrying
				end

				if w.carrying and w.rank ~= A.rank then
					return w.rank > A.rank
				end

				return w.distance < A.distance
			end)

			return f
		end

		U.friendCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		function U.isFriend(w)
			local A = U.friendCache

			if A[w] == nil then
				A[w] = false
				task.spawn(function()
					local r, f = pcall(LocalPlayer.IsFriendsWith, LocalPlayer, w.UserId)

					if r and f then
						A[w] = true
					end
				end)
			end

			return A[w] == true
		end
		function U:_pick()
			local w = senaV4Config.StealPlayerTarget
			local A, r

			for f, f in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				local m = w == nil or w == "" or w == "Any Player" or f.player.Name == w
				local y = f.player.Name == w or senaV4Config.SkipFriends == false or not U.isFriend(f.player)
				local F = f.root.Position.X > 672.2 and f.player:GetAttribute("InBossArena") ~= true

				if m and y and F and self:_passes(f.record) then
					local F = self.catalog.resolve(f.record).rarityRank or 0

					if not r or F > r then
						A, r = f, F
					end
				end
			end

			return A
		end
		function U:strike(F)
			if not F or F == LocalPlayer then
				return false
			end

			for w, w in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				if w.player == F then
					self.forced = true
					task.spawn(function()
						self:_chase(w)
					end)

					return true
				end
			end

			self:_setStatus(F.Name .. " is not carrying an egg")

			return false
		end

		local function F()
			local w = LocalPlayer.Character

			if not w then
				return
			end

			local A = w:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local r = w:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			for f, f in ipairs(w:GetDescendants()) do
				if f:IsA("Motor6D") then
					if not f.Enabled then
						f.Enabled = true
					end
				elseif f:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or f:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
					if f.Name:find("Ragdoll") or f:GetAttribute("RagdollConstraint") then
						pcall(function()
							f:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				elseif f:IsA("Attachment") and (f.Name:find("Ragdoll") or f:GetAttribute("RagdollAttachment")) then
					pcall(function()
						f:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end

			if A then
				A.PlatformStand = false
				A.Sit = false
				pcall(function()
					A:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
					A:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
					A:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
					A:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
					A:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
					task.wait(0.02)
					A:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
				end)
			end

			if r then
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end
		local function w()
			local A = v14()
			local T = A and A:FindFirstChild("Areas")
			local A = T and T:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas")
			local T = A and A:FindFirstChild("Forest")

			if T then
				local A = T:FindFirstChild("Guard")
				local r = A and (A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or A:FindFirstChild("Collider") or (A:IsA("Model") and A.PrimaryPart))

				if A and r then
					return A, r
				end

				local A = T:FindFirstChild("ForestGuardAuthored")
				local T = A and (A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or (A:IsA("Model") and A.PrimaryPart))

				if A and T then
					return A, T
				end
			end

			local T = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaGuards")

			if T then
				for A, A in ipairs(T:GetChildren()) do
					local T = A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if T and T.Position.X < 850 then
						return A, T
					end
				end
			end

			return nil, nil
		end
		local function T(A)
			local r = nil

			pcall(function()
				r = a.ReadFieldEggs()
			end)

			local f = (r and r.Records) or {}
			local r = nil

			for m, m in ipairs(f) do
				if (m.State == "Slot" or m.State == "Dropped") and m.Uid ~= A and (not m.CarrierUserId or m.CarrierUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId) then
					local A = (m.BottomCFrame and m.BottomCFrame.Position) or (m.BoundsCFrame and m.BoundsCFrame.Position)
					local f = (m.AreaId == "Forest") or tostring(m.Uid):find("Forest", 1, true) or tostring(m.Uid):find("^FirstArea") or (A and A.X < 680)

					if f then
						if m.State == "Slot" then
							r = m

							break
						elseif not r then
							r = m
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return r
		end

		U._primeForest = function(A, r)
			local f = A.eggRuntime
			local m, y, e = v8()

			if not (y and e and e.Health > 0) then
				return false
			end

			if f and f.carry and f.carry.active and f.carry.uid then
				pcall(function()
					f:_returnToSafe()
				end)
				task.wait(0.08)
			end

			A:_setStatus("Preparing steal")

			local f = T(r)

			if not f then
				A:_setStatus("Steal unavailable — retrying")

				return false
			end

			local T = (f.BottomCFrame and f.BottomCFrame.Position) or (f.BoundsCFrame and f.BoundsCFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(596.6, 67.7, -325.0)
			local r = Vector3.new(T.X, T.Y + 2.5, T.Z)
			local T = "Forest:" .. tostring(f.NestId or "Slot_001")

			pcall(function()
				local u = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.AreaEggSlotIdentity)

				if u and f.AreaId and f.NestId then
					T = u.SlotKey(f.AreaId, f.NestId)
				end
			end)
			A:_setStatus("Preparing steal")
			y.CFrame = CFrame.new(r)
			y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			y.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

			local u = false
			local C = os.clock()
			local g = 0

			while not u and os.clock() - C < 0.8 do
				y = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or y

				if y and y.Position.Y < 65 then
					y.CFrame = CFrame.new(r)
					y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end

				if os.clock() >= g then
					g = os.clock() + 0.1
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(function()
							a.CarryFieldEgg(f.Uid, T)
						end)
					end)
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(function()
							local r = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

							if r and r.EggWorld and r.EggWorld.AskFieldEggCarry then
								r.EggWorld.AskFieldEggCarry:InvokeServer({ Uid = f.Uid, FirstAreaSlotKey = T })
							end
						end)
					end)
				end

				local T = nil

				pcall(function()
					T = a.ReadFieldEgg(f.Uid)
				end)

				if T and T.State == "Carried" and T.CarrierUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
					u = true

					break
				end

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			if not u then
				A:_setStatus("Steal unavailable — retrying")
				F()

				return false
			end

			A:_setStatus("Preparing steal")

			local T, r = w()
			local u = T and (T:FindFirstChild("Collider") or r)
			local u = (r and r.Position) or Vector3.new(596.6, 69.4, -317.1)

			y.CFrame = CFrame.new(u.X, u.Y + 0.8, u.Z)
			y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			y.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

			local y = false
			local C = A.attemptConnections

			pcall(function()
				local g = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages") and ReplicatedStorage.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking") and ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networking:FindFirstChild("RE/RigSync/Refresh")

				if g then
					table.insert(C, g.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
						y = true
					end))
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				local g = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

				if g and g.EggWorld and g.EggWorld.OwnerDropped then
					table.insert(C, g.EggWorld.OwnerDropped.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
						y = true
					end))
				end
			end)

			if e then
				table.insert(C, e.StateChanged:Connect(function(g, g)
					if g == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or g == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or g == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
						y = true
					end
				end))
				table.insert(C, e:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlatformStand"):Connect(function()
					if e.PlatformStand then
						y = true
					end
				end))
			end

			local function e()
				T, r = w()

				local w = (r and r.Position) or u
				local g = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if g then
					g.CFrame = CFrame.new(w.X, w.Y + 0.8, w.Z)
					g.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end

				local m = (T and T:FindFirstChild("Collider")) or r

				if m and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" and g then
					pcall(function()
						firetouchinterest(g, m, 0)
						firetouchinterest(g, m, 1)
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					local T = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

					if T and T.GuardPatrol and T.GuardPatrol.ForestStrike then
						T.GuardPatrol.ForestStrike:FireServer({ EggUid = f.Uid, GuardCFrame = (r and r.CFrame) or CFrame.new(w) })
					end
				end)
			end

			A:_setStatus("Preparing steal")
			e()

			local T = os.clock() + 0.75
			local w = os.clock() + 0.05

			while os.clock() < T do
				if y then
					break
				end

				local T = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if T and (T.PlatformStand or T.Sit) then
					y = true

					break
				end

				local T = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if T and T.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 18 then
					y = true

					break
				end

				if T and T.Position.Y < 65 then
					T.CFrame = CFrame.new(u.X, 70.0, u.Z)
					T.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end

				if os.clock() >= w then
					w = os.clock() + 0.05
					e()
				end

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			for T, T in ipairs(C) do
				pcall(T.Disconnect, T)
			end

			if not y then
				A:_setStatus("Steal unavailable — retrying")
				F()

				return false, f.Uid
			end

			A:_setStatus("Preparing steal")
			F()

			local T = os.clock() + 0.35

			while os.clock() < T do
				local T = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local w = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if T and w and not T.PlatformStand and not T.Sit then
					local A = T:GetState()

					if A ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll and A ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown and A ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
						w.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						w.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

						break
					end
				end

				F()
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			return true, f.Uid
		end

		function U:_bats()
			local F = genv.__SenaV4Bats
			local T = {}

			if not (F and type(F.isBat) == "function") then
				return T
			end

			for w, w in ipairs({ LocalPlayer.Character, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
				for A, A in ipairs(w and w:GetChildren() or {}) do
					if F.isBat(A) then
						T[#T + 1] = A
					end
				end
			end

			return T
		end
		function U:_rotateBat(F)
			local T = self:_bats()

			if #T < 2 then
				return F, false
			end

			local w = LocalPlayer.Character
			local A = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

			local function r(f)
				return tonumber(f:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0
			end

			if F and F.Parent == w and r(F) <= A and F:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") ~= true then
				return F, true
			end

			local A = (F and table.find(T, F)) and F or nil

			for F, F in ipairs(T) do
				if not A or r(F) < r(A) then
					A = F
				end
			end

			if A and A.Parent ~= w then
				local F = w and w:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if F then
					pcall(F.EquipTool, F, A)
					self.batSwapAt = os.clock()
				end
			end

			return A, true
		end
		function U:_swingBatAt(F, T)
			if not T or T.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
				return false
			end

			self.swingSeq += 1

			local T = string.format("%d:%d:%d", LocalPlayer.UserId, self.swingSeq, math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 1000))

			return pcall(function()
				require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).BatSwing.Trigger:FireServer(F, T)
			end)
		end
		function U:_dropUnwanted()
			local F = nil

			pcall(function()
				for T, T in ipairs(a.ReadFieldEggs().Records or {}) do
					if T.State == "Carried" and T.CarrierUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
						F = a.ReadFieldEgg(T.Uid) or T

						break
					end
				end
			end)

			if F and not self:_passes(F) then
				pcall(a.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
				task.wait(0.3)

				return true
			end

			return false
		end
		function U:_returnSafe()
			self:_dropUnwanted()

			local F = self.eggRuntime
			local _, T, w = v8()

			if not (F and T and w) or F:_isInSafeArea(T) then
				return
			end

			local A = F:_resolveSafeCFrame(T)

			if not A then
				return
			end

			self:_setStatus("Returning to safe zone")
			v629(T, w, A, function()
				return w.Health <= 0 or not T.Parent
			end, false, nil, true)
		end
		function U:intercept(F, T)
			if self.running then
				return false
			end

			local w = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not w then
				return false
			end

			for A, A in ipairs(self:carriers()) do
				if A.record.Uid == F then
					if A.root.Position.X <= 552.2 or (A.root.Position - w.Position).Magnitude > (T and 250 or 80) or (not T and not self:_passes(A.record)) then
						return false
					end

					self.forced = true
					task.spawn(self._chase, self, A, true)

					return self.running
				end
			end

			return false
		end
		function U:_runAttempt(F, T, ...)
			if self.running then
				return
			end

			self.running = true
			self.wantsTarget = false
			self.attemptCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character

			local w = self.attemptCharacter and self.attemptCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local A = self.attemptCharacter and self.attemptCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local r = A and A.AutoRotate

			self.attemptConnections = {}
			self.attemptCollisions = {}

			local f, m = xpcall(F, debug.traceback, self, ...)

			if not f and w then
				if t5[w] then
					t5[w].cancelled = true
					t5[w] = nil
				end

				pcall(v72)
				pcall(v73)
				pcall(function()
					if A and A.Parent then
						A.AutoRotate = r
					end
				end)
			end

			for F, F in ipairs(self.attemptConnections) do
				pcall(F.Disconnect, F)
			end

			for F, L in pairs(self.attemptCollisions) do
				pcall(function()
					if F.Parent then
						F.CanCollide = L
					end
				end)
			end

			self.attemptConnections, self.attemptCollisions = nil, nil
			self.attemptCharacter = nil
			self.cardTarget = nil
			self.running, self.forced, self.wantsTarget = false, false, false

			if not f then
				if T and T.Uid then
					self.blacklist[T.Uid] = os.clock() + 20
				end

				warn("[Sena] Steal from player failed: " .. tostring(m))
			end

			self:_setStatus(self.enabled and "looking for a carrier" or "idle")
		end
		function U:_chase(F, L)
			return self:_runAttempt(self._chaseBody, F.record, F, L)
		end

		U._chaseBody = function(F, L, s)
			local T = genv.__SenaV4EnsureNormalWorld

			if type(T) ~= "function" or not T("auto_steal", function()
				return F.enabled or F.forced
			end) then
				return
			end

			F.attempts += 1

			local T = L.record
			local x = T.Uid
			local w = F.catalog.resolve(T)
			local A = L.player
			local L = A.DisplayName or A.Name

			F.cardTarget = { uid = x, record = T, player = L }

			if F.godMode then
				F.godMode:stopDefend()
			end

			if not s then
				F:_returnSafe()
				F:_setStatus(string.format("Preparing to steal from %s", L))

				local r, f, m = pcall(F._primeForest, F, x)
				local y = nil

				if r and not f and m then
					pcall(function()
						y = a.ReadFieldEgg(m)
					end)
				end

				if y and y.State == "Carried" and y.CarrierUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
					F:_returnSafe()
					F:_log(L, w.name, "could not prepare")
					F:_setStatus(F.enabled and "looking for a carrier" or "idle")

					return
				end
			end

			local r = F.godMode and F.godMode:_equipBat()
			local f = os.clock() + (s and 8 or 16)
			local s = "could not catch them"
			local m, y = 0, 0
			local e, u, C = nil, nil, nil
			local g = nil
			local o = nil
			local p = {}
			local G = Vector3.zero
			local H = A:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false
			local O = 0.1

			pcall(function()
				O = math.clamp(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() or 0.1, 0.03, 0.6)
			end)

			local K = math.clamp(0.14 + O, 0.14, 0.35)

			F.leadIdx = F.hitIdx or F.leadIdx or 1
			F.missStreak = 0

			local O = nil

			pcall(function()
				O = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
					local J = LocalPlayer.Character

					if J then
						for n, n in ipairs(J:GetDescendants()) do
							if n:IsA("BasePart") then
								if F.attemptCollisions[n] == nil then
									F.attemptCollisions[n] = n.CanCollide
								end

								n.CanCollide = false
							end
						end
					end
				end)
			end)

			if O then
				table.insert(F.attemptConnections, O)
			end

			F:_setStatus(string.format("Chasing %s", L))

			while os.clock() < f do
				local f = RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()

				if LocalPlayer.Character ~= F.attemptCharacter then
					s = "character changed"

					break
				end

				if not F.enabled and not F.forced then
					s = "stopped"

					break
				end

				if t8.blocker("auto_steal") then
					s = "yielding to a higher priority task"

					break
				end

				local R = nil

				pcall(function()
					R = a.ReadFieldEgg(x)
				end)

				local J = R and R.State

				if not R or J == "Slot" or J == "GuardCarried" then
					s = "egg reset"

					break
				end

				if J == "Claimed" then
					s = "they banked it"

					break
				end

				if J == "Carried" and R.CarrierUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
					s = "taken"

					break
				end

				if J == "Dropped" then
					local J = os.clock()
					local n = (A:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false) ~= H
					local l = g ~= nil and ((e ~= nil and J - e <= 1) or (o ~= nil and J - o <= 1.5) or n)

					if l then
						if e and J - e <= 1 then
							F.hitIdx = F.leadIdx
						end

						F:_setStatus(string.format("Grabbing dropped egg from %s", L))
						s = F:_grab(R, A, r) and "taken" or "someone else grabbed it"
					else
						s = F:_grabForeignDrop(R, A, r) and "taken" or "someone else grabbed it"
					end

					break
				end

				local J, n, l = v8()

				if not n or not l or l.Health <= 0 then
					s = "character died"

					break
				end

				if R.CarrierUserId ~= A.UserId then
					local i = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(R.CarrierUserId or 0)

					if not i then
						s = "taken by another player"

						break
					end

					A = i
					L = A.DisplayName or A.Name
					H = A:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false
					g, e = nil, nil
					table.clear(p)
					F:_setStatus(string.format("Chasing %s", L))
				end

				local R = A.Character and A.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if not R then
					s = "lost sight of them"

					break
				end

				if R.Position.X <= 552.2 then
					s = "banked"

					break
				end

				local i = os.clock()

				p[#p + 1] = { t = i, p = R.Position }

				while #p > 2 and i - p[1].t > 0.4 do
					table.remove(p, 1)
				end

				local b = R.AssemblyLinearVelocity

				if Vector3.new(b.X, 0, b.Z).Magnitude > 8 then
					G = b
				elseif #p >= 2 and i - p[1].t > 0.15 then
					G = (R.Position - p[1].p) / (i - p[1].t)
				end

				local p = Vector3.new(G.X, 0, G.Z)
				local G = p.Magnitude
				local i

				if G > 6 then
					i = p.Unit
				else
					local p = R.CFrame.LookVector

					p = Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
					i = p.Magnitude > 0.05 and p.Unit or Vector3.new(-1.0, 0, 0)
				end

				local p = math.clamp((Z[F.leadIdx] or 1) * G * K, 3, 60)
				local b = R.Position + i * p

				if b.X < 557.2 then
					b = Vector3.new(557.2, b.Y, b.Z)
				end

				local p = Vector3.new(R.Position.X, b.Y, R.Position.Z)

				if (p - b).Magnitude < 0.5 then
					p = b - i
				end

				local i = CFrame.lookAt(b, p)
				local p = b - n.Position
				local b = p.Magnitude
				local V = v69()
				local v = V * math.min(f, 0.05)
				local Y

				v76(J, V * t4.HEADROOM)

				if b > v then
					n.CFrame = CFrame.new(n.Position + p.Unit * v) * i.Rotation
					n.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					Y = p.Unit * V
				else
					n.CFrame = i
					n.AssemblyLinearVelocity = R.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					Y = R.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				end

				n.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

				if not v83(l, n, V, Y) then
					v82(l, n, V)
					v83(l, n, V, Y)
				end

				local p = G * f * 1.5

				if b <= 5 + p then
					if not g then
						g = os.clock()
					end

					F:_setStatus(R.Position.X <= 1245 and string.format("Attacking %s", L) or string.format("Chasing %s", L))
				elseif b > 12 + p and g then
					g = nil
					F:_setStatus(string.format("Chasing %s", L))
				end

				local f = A:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or false

				if f ~= H then
					H = f
					o = os.clock()
					F.hitIdx = F.leadIdx
					F.missStreak = 0
					e = nil
				end

				if (not r or r.Parent ~= J) and os.clock() >= y then
					y = os.clock() + 0.5
					task.spawn(function()
						r = F.godMode and F.godMode:_equipBat() or r
					end)
				end

				local f = false

				if r and r.Parent == J then
					r, f = F:_rotateBat(r)

					if f then
						y = os.clock() + 0.5
					end
				end

				local y = r and tonumber(r:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0

				if e and os.clock() - e > 0.9 then
					local o = C and C.Parent and tonumber(C:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or y

					if o ~= u then
						F.missStreak += 1

						if F.missStreak >= 2 then
							F.missStreak = 0
							F.leadIdx = (F.leadIdx % #Z) + 1
							g = nil
						end
					end

					e = nil
				end

				if r and r.Parent == J and g and os.clock() - g >= K + 0.05 and R.Position.X <= 1245 and r:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") ~= true and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= y and os.clock() - m >= (f and 0.12 or 0.35) and os.clock() - (F.batSwapAt or 0) >= (f and 0.15 or 0) then
					m = os.clock()

					if not e then
						e, u, C = os.clock(), y, r
					end

					task.spawn(F._swingBatAt, F, A, r)
				end
			end

			if O then
				pcall(function()
					O:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			if s == "taken" then
				F.taken += 1
				F:_deliver(x, T)
			else
				F.blacklist[x] = os.clock() + 20
				F:_returnSafe()
			end

			F:_log(L, w.name, s)
			F:_setStatus(F.enabled and "looking for a carrier" or "idle")
		end

		function U:_grabForeignDrop(F, R, L)
			local s = F.Uid

			local function T()
				local x = nil

				pcall(function()
					x = a.ReadFieldEgg(s)
				end)

				return x
			end

			local _, s, x = v8()

		function U:_snipeBody(F, R)
			self.attempts += 1

			local L = F.Uid

			local R = T and (T.DisplayName or T.Name) or "?"

		function U:_watchDrops()
			if self.dropConns then

			end

				if not F() or type(R) ~= "table" or not R.Uid then
					return
				end

				if R.State == "Carried" then
					self.lastCarrier[R.Uid] = R.CarrierUserId

					return
				end

				if R.State ~= "Dropped" then
					self.lastCarrier[R.Uid] = nil

					return
				end

				local L = self.lastCarrier[R.Uid]

				if not L or L == LocalPlayer.UserId then
					return
				end

					return

					return

					return
				end

					return

					return
				end

			end))
			table.insert(self.dropConns, a.FieldGone:Connect(function(R)
				if F() then

				end
			end))
		end

		U._grab = function(F, R, L, s, d, T)
			local x = F.eggRuntime
			local k = R.Uid
			local w = nil

			pcall(function()
				w = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.RagdollJoints)
			end)

			local function Z()
				local A = nil

				pcall(function()
					A = a.ReadFieldEgg(k)
				end)

				return A
			end
			local function A(r, f)
				pcall(function()
					if w and w.Release then
						w.Release(r)
					end

					f.PlatformStand = false
					f.Sit = false

					if f:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
						f:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
					end
				end)
			end
			local function w(r, f, m)
				local y = x and x:_resolveEggDestination(r, f, m)

			end
			local function r(f, m, y, e)
				m.CFrame = e
				m.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				m.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

				local e = math.clamp(v69(), t4.MIN_SPEED, t4.MAX_SPEED)

				v76(f, e * t4.HEADROOM)

				if not v83(y, m, e, Vector3.zero) then
					v82(y, m, e)
				end
			end
			local function z()
				if not (L and s) then
					return
				end

				local _ = LocalPlayer.Character

				if not _ then
					return
				end

				local W

				s, W = F:_rotateBat(s)

				if not s or s.Parent ~= _ then
					return
				end

				if W and os.clock() - (F.batSwapAt or 0) < 0.15 then
					return
				end

				local _ = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				local W = tonumber(s:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0

				if _ >= W and s:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") ~= true then
					task.spawn(F._swingBatAt, F, L, s)
				end
			end

			local L = 2.5

			pcall(function()
				L = math.clamp(x:_resolveSettleSeconds(R), 1.5, 4)
			end)

			if T then
				L = math.max(L, T)
			end

			local R = nil
			local _ = d and 0 or os.clock() + L

			while os.clock() < _ do
				if (not F.enabled and not F.forced) or LocalPlayer.Character ~= F.attemptCharacter then
					return false
				end

				local L = Z()
				local s = L and L.State

				if s == "Carried" then
					if L.CarrierUserId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
						return false
					end

					return true
				end

				if s ~= "Dropped" and s ~= "Slot" then
					return false
				end

				local s, W, d = v8()

				if not W or not d or d.Health <= 0 then
					return false
				end

				A(s, d)
				R = w(L, W, d) or R

				if R then
					r(s, W, d, R)
				end

				z()
				F:_setStatus(string.format("Securing dropped egg (%ds)", math.ceil(_ - os.clock())))
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			local S, L = false, false
			local _ = os.clock() + 3.5

			while os.clock() < _ do
				if (not F.enabled and not F.forced) or LocalPlayer.Character ~= F.attemptCharacter then
					return false
				end

				local _ = Z()
				local s = _ and _.State

				if s == "Carried" then
					if _.CarrierUserId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
						return false
					end

					if genv.__SenaV4Webhook then
						local W, d = pcall(F.catalog.resolve, _)

						pcall(genv.__SenaV4Webhook.stolen, _, W and d or nil, "player carry")
					end

					return true
				end

				if s ~= "Dropped" and s ~= "Slot" then
					return false
				end

				local F, s, W = v8()

				if not s or not W or W.Health <= 0 then
					return false
				end

				A(F, W)

				local d = w(_, s, W) or R

				if d then
					r(F, s, W, d)
				end

				z()

				if not S then
					S = true
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(function()
							require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).EggWorld.AskFieldEggCarry:InvokeServer({ Uid = k })
						end)
						S = false
					end)
				end

				if not L then
					L = true
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(function()
							a.CarryFieldEgg(k)
						end)
						L = false
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					local a = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
					local S = a and a:FindFirstChild(tostring(k))
					local a = S and (S:FindFirstChild("CarryAreaEgg", true) or S:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))

					if a and a.Enabled and type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
						a.HoldDuration = 0
						a.RequiresLineOfSight = false
						fireproximityprompt(a, 0)
					end
				end)
				task.wait(0.06)
			end

			return false
		end

		function U:_start()
			self:_watchDrops()

			if self.loop then
				return
			end

			self.loop = task.spawn(function()
				while v20() do
					task.wait(0.4)

					if genv.ChloeX_Running == nil and genv.__SenaV4PlayerSteal ~= self then
						break
					end

					for a, S in pairs(self.blacklist) do
						if os.clock() > S then
							self.blacklist[a] = nil
						end
					end

					local a = self.eggRuntime
					local S = genv.__SenaV4ButterflyRuntime
					local F = a and (a.running or (a.carry and a.carry.active))
					local a = S ~= nil and S.active == true
					local S = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InPumpkinArena") == true or (genv.__SenaV4BossBusy ~= nil and genv.__SenaV4BossBusy() == true) or (genv.__SenaV4ManorBusy ~= nil and genv.__SenaV4ManorBusy() == true)
					local R = nil

					if self.enabled and not self.running and not F and not S then
						local S, F = pcall(self._pick, self)

						if S then
							R = F
						else
							warn("[Sena] Carrier lookup failed: " .. tostring(F))
						end
					end

					self.wantsTarget = R ~= nil and not a

					if R and not a then
						self:_chase(R)
					end
				end

				self.loop = nil
				self.wantsTarget = false
			end)
		end

		return U

			end

				return
			end

			local W = self:_root()

			end

		function d:_gameWalkSpeed()
			local a = self.speedModules

			if not a then
				a = {}
				pcall(function()
					a.TreadmillUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.TreadmillUtil)
				end)

				end)

				end)

			end

				return nil
			end

			local S = nil

			if a.Projection then
				pcall(function()
					S = a.Projection.ReadProjected()
				end)
			end

			if type(S) ~= "number" and a.Save then
				pcall(function()
					S = (a.Save.Peek or a.Save.Get)().SpeedPower
				end)
			end

			if type(S) ~= "number" then
				return nil
			end

			return F and tonumber(R) or nil
		end

		function d:_applySpeedMultiplier()

			if a and a.activeTreadmill ~= nil then
				return
			end

			local a = self:_humanoid()

			if not a then
				return
			end

			local S = self:_gameWalkSpeed()

			if not S or S <= 0 then
				return
			end

			local F = S * self.speedMultiplier

			if math.abs(a.WalkSpeed - F) > 0.05 then
				pcall(function()
					a.WalkSpeed = F
				end)
			end
		end

	t43.tradeUp = function()
		t43.snapshot()

		if not t43.canTrade() then
			return false, "nothing to trade up"
		end

		local a, s = v5144("ButterflyMachine")

		if not a then
			return false, s
		end

		local a, S, s = t43.tiers(), senaV4Config.ButterflyTradeRecipe, 0

		if S == "Smart" then
			local z = table.clone(t43.snap.counts)

			while s < 50 do
				local W = t43.smartNext(z)

				if not W then
					break
				end

				t43.status = "Trading up " .. a[W].name .. " for the essence"

				local d, M = v5039("Butterflies", "AskTradeUp", W)

				if not d then
					if s == 0 then
						return false, M or "the machine refused"
					end

					break
				end

				s = s + 1
				z[W] = (z[W] or 0) - a[W].trade

				local d = t44[t45[W] + 1]

				z[d] = (z[d] or 0) + 1
				task.wait(0.12)
			end

			return true, s
		end

		for F = 3, 1, -1.0 do
			local z = t44[F]

			if S == nil or S == "All" or S == z then
				local S, F = t43.snap.counts[z] or 0, a[z].trade

				while F > 0 and S >= F do
					t43.status = "Trading up " .. a[z].name

					local a, R = v5039("Butterflies", "AskTradeUp", z)

					if not a then
						if s == 0 then
							return false, R or "the machine refused"
						end

						break
					end

					s = s + 1
					S = S - F
					task.wait(0.12)
				end
			end
		end

		return true, s
	end

			local z = W

			if R and L and type(L.Decode) == "function" then
				local R, d = pcall(L.Decode, W)

				if R and type(d) == "table" then
					z = d
				end
			end

			if type(z) == "table" and a[z.Category] then
				S.pets += 1

				if not F[s] and not z.InFuse and not z.IsFavorite then
					local a = _[z.Category] or {}

					_[z.Category] = a
					a[#a + 1] = s

					if #a > S.best then
						S.best = #a
					end

					if #a >= 3 and not S.group then
						S.group = { a[1], a[2], a[3] }
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return S
	end

	t43.solveBanjo = function()
		local q = v5029()
		local a = q.Remotes and q.Remotes.BanjoCricket

		if not (a and a.Effect and a.Aim) then
			return false, "Banjo remotes missing"
		end

		local q = t43.banjoPrompt("BanjoCricketTalk") or t43.banjoPrompt("BanjoCricket")

		if not q then
			return false, "Banjo Cricket not found"
		end

		local _, s = 0.45, 0.2

		pcall(function()
			local W = require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.BanjoCricket).Timing

			_ = tonumber(W.Note) or _
			s = tonumber(W.NoteGap) or s
		end)

		local z = { notes = nil, cleared = 0, solved = false }
		local W = a.Effect.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(d)
			if type(d) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			if d.Kind == "Playback" and type(d.Notes) == "table" then
				z.notes = d.Notes
			elseif d.Kind == "StageComplete" then
				z.cleared = tonumber(d.Cleared) or (z.cleared + 1)
			elseif d.Kind == "Solved" then
				z.solved = true
			elseif d.Kind == "Wrong" or d.Kind == "Reset" then
				z.cleared = 0
			end
		end)

		t43.status = "Talking to the Banjo Cricket"
		t43.firePrompt(q)

		local d, M = os.clock() + 150, os.clock()

		while v20() and senaV4Config.BanjoAuto and os.clock() < d and not z.solved do
			if t43.manual or t8.blocker("butterfly") ~= nil then
				break
			end

			if t43.snapshot().banjoSolved then
				z.solved = true

				break
			end

			local S = z.notes

			if S then
				z.notes = nil
				t43.status = ("Banjo Cricket  ·  stage %d  ·  %d notes"):format(z.cleared + 1, #S)
				task.wait(#S * (_ + s) + 0.3)

				for F, F in ipairs(S) do
					if z.notes then
						break
					end

					if not t43.hitMushroom(F, a) then
						z.err = "equip a bat first (the mushrooms only take bat hits)"

						break
					end
				end

				if z.err then
					break
				end

				M = os.clock()
			elseif os.clock() - M > 8 then
				t43.firePrompt(q)
				M = os.clock()
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		W:Disconnect()

		return z.solved, z.solved and nil or (z.err or "the cricket stopped playing")
	end
	t43.hitMushroom = function(a, s)
		local W = v5045()
		local d = LocalPlayer.Character
		local _ = d and d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not (W and _) then
			return false
		end

		local d, M, I = nil, Vector3.zero, 0

		for Q, Q in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("BanjoCricketMushroom")) do
			local T = Q:IsA("Model") and Q:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and Q:GetAttribute("MushroomIndex")
			local x = typeof(T) == "number" and (Q:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or Q.PrimaryPart)

			if x and x:IsA("BasePart") then
				M, I = M + x.Position, I + 1

				if T == a then
					d = x
				end
			end
		end

		if not d then
			return false
		end

		local Q = genv.__SenaV4GodMode
		local L = Q and Q:_equipBat()

		if not L then
			return false
		end

		local Q = (M / I - d.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

		if Q.Magnitude < 0.5 then
			Q = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
		end

		local M = d.Position + Q.Unit * 7

		M = Vector3.new(M.X, W.Position.Y, M.Z)

		local I = Vector3.new(d.Position.X, M.Y, d.Position.Z)

		if (W.Position - M).Magnitude > 3 then
			pcall(v629, W, _, CFrame.lookAt(M, I), function()
				return not v20()
			end)
			W = v5045()

			if not W then
				return false
			end
		end

		W.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(W.Position, Vector3.new(I.X, W.Position.Y, I.Z))
		task.wait(0.08)
		pcall(s.Aim.FireServer, s.Aim, a)

		local a = os.clock() + 1.5

		while os.clock() < a do
			local a = L:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")
			local S = L:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") == true and typeof(a) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < a

			if not S and os.clock() - (t43.lastMushroomHit or 0) >= 0.75 then
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		t43.lastMushroomHit = os.clock()
		pcall(function()
			L:Activate()
		end)
		task.wait(0.15)

		return true
	end

	t51.pick = function(a)

				if z then

			end

	end
	t51.gain = function()

	t51.swing = function(a, _)
		if t51.swinging then
			return
		end

		local s = tonumber(v5034("SwingCooldownSeconds", 0.45)) or 0.45

		if os.clock() - t43.lastSwing < s then
			return
		end

		local S = v5029()

		if not (S and S.Swarm and S.Swarm.Nearest) then
			return
		end

		local F, s = pcall(S.Swarm.Nearest, _, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0), 4)
		local S = F and s and s.Flight

		if not (S and S.Id) then
			return
		end

		if S.Tier ~= nil and tostring(S.Tier) ~= a.Name then
			return
		end

		t43.lastSwing = os.clock()
		t51.swinging = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local _, _, F = v5039("Butterflies", "AskSwing", S.Id)

			t51.swinging = false

			if F ~= "Caught" and F ~= "Gone" then
				t51.skip[a] = os.clock() + 1.5
			end

			if t51.target == a then
				t51.target = nil
			end

			local S = t43.tiers()
			local R = S and S[a.Name] and S[a.Name].name or a.Name

			t43.status = ("%s %s  ·  +%d this Bloom"):format(F == "Caught" and "Caught" or "Chasing", R, t51.gain())
		end)
	end

	t51.keepGoing = function(a, s, W)
		if not (v20() and senaV4Config.ButterflyAutoCatch and t43.bloomLeft() > 0 and a.Parent and s.Health > 0) then
			return false
		end

		if (senaV4Config.ButterflyCatchMode or "Tween") ~= W then

	t51.moveStep = function(a, Q, T, x, h, k, B)
		if LocalPlayer.Character ~= a or not genv.__SenaV4MovementWorldReady(false) then
			return false
		end

		v76(a, k * t4.HEADROOM)

		local a = v75()[t4.INTEGRITY_KEY]
		local F = type(a) == "table" and a.State or nil

		if not v81(F, Q, T) then
			T.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			T.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			v70(T.Position)

			if v80(F, Q, T) then
				v78(F, k * t4.HEADROOM, Vector3.zero)
			else
				v82(Q, T, k)
			end

			return nil
		end

		local a = T.Position
		local S = x - a
		local F = k * B
		local R = S.Magnitude <= F and x or (a + S.Unit * F)
		local F = (h or x) - R
		local z = Vector3.new(F.X, 0, F.Z)

		if z.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
			z = Vector3.new(S.X, 0, S.Z)
		end

		local S = z.Magnitude > 0.001 and z.Unit or T.CFrame.LookVector
		local F = (R - a) / B

		v70(R)
		T.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(R, R + S)
		T.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		T.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		if not v83(Q, T, k, F) then
			v82(Q, T, k)
			v83(Q, T, k, F)
		end

		return R
	end
	t51.nearest = function(a, z)
		local L = workspace:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloomSwarm")

		if not L then
			return nil
		end

		local _, s = v5097(), os.clock()
		local R, W, d = nil, nil, z

		for z, z in ipairs(L:GetChildren()) do
			if z:IsA("Model") and t45[z.Name] and (not _ or _[z.Name]) and (t51.skip[z] or 0) <= s then
				local F = t51.pos(z)
				local S = F and (F - a).Magnitude

				if S and S <= d then
					R, W, d = z, F, S
				end
			end
		end

		return R, W
	end
	t51.cluster = function(a)
		local R = workspace:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloomSwarm")
		local z = {}

		for L, L in ipairs(R and R:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if L:IsA("Model") and t45[L.Name] then
				local F = t51.pos(L)

				if F then
					z[#z + 1] = F
				end
			end
		end

		if #z == 0 then
			return nil, 0, 0
		end

		local S = 0

		for F, F in ipairs(z) do
			if a and (F - a).Magnitude <= 24 then
				S = S + 1
			end
		end

		local F, R = nil, nil

		for L, L in ipairs(z) do
			local _, s = Vector3.zero, 0

			for W, W in ipairs(z) do
				if (L - W).Magnitude <= 24 then
					_, s = _ + W, s + 1
				end
			end

			local L = _ / s
			local _ = s * 100 - (a and (L - a).Magnitude or 0)

			if not R or _ > R then
				F, R = L, _
			end
		end

		return F, #z, S
	end
	t51.route = function(a, F, R)
		if a == "Circle" then
			local _, z = 24, R * 2.0833333333333335

			return F + Vector3.new(math.cos(z) * 24, 0, math.sin(z) * 24)
		end

		local z = v5148()

		if a ~= "Zigzag" or not z then
			return F
		end

		local a = math.max(z.Size.X / 2 - 12, 20)
		local S = math.clamp(z.Size.Z / 2 - 12, 8, 30)
		local L = math.sqrt((2 * a / 8) ^ 2 + (2 * S) ^ 2)
		local _ = (R * 80 / L) % 16.0
		local R = math.floor(_)
		local L = _ - R
		local _ = R <= 8 and R or 16.0 - R
		local s = R + 1 <= 8 and R + 1 or 16.0 - (R + 1)
		local W, d = -a + _ * (2 * a / 8), (R % 2 == 0) and -S or S
		local _, M = -a + s * (2 * a / 8), ((R + 1) % 2 == 0) and -S or S
		local a = z.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(W + (_ - W) * L, 0, d + (M - d) * L))

		return Vector3.new(z.Position.X + a.X, F.Y, z.Position.Z + a.Z)
	end
	t51.patrol = function(q)
		local W, d, M, I = t51.prepare()

		if not W then
			return false
		end

		local Q = tonumber(v5034("NetReach", 14)) or 14
		local L = ({ Stand = "Standing in the swarm", Zigzag = "Zigzag patrol", Circle = "Circling the swarm" })[q] or q
		local T, x, h = nil, 0, os.clock()
		local k, B, D = nil, false, 0

		while t51.keepGoing(d, M, q) do
			local j = math.max(math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), CLAMP), 0.004166666666666667)
			local a = os.clock()

			if a >= x then
				local s, w, U = t51.cluster(T)

				x = a + 1.5

				if w == 0 then
					k = k or a
				else
					k = nil

					if q == "Stand" then
						if not T or U < 3 then
							T = s
						end
					else
						T = T and T:Lerp(s, 0.5) or s
					end
				end
			end

			if k and a - k > 2 then
				break
			end

			if not T then
				d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				v70(d.Position)
			else
				B = true

				local R = t51.route(q, T, a - h)
				local s = (R - d.Position).Magnitude > 40 and math.huge or (q == "Stand" and 60 or (q == "Circle" and 70 or 110))
				local q = math.clamp(math.min(v69(), s), t4.MIN_SPEED, t4.MAX_SPEED)
				local z = t51.nearest(d.Position, Q + 6)
				local s = t51.moveStep(W, M, d, R, _, q, j)

				if s and z and (_ - s).Magnitude <= Q - 1.5 then
					t51.swing(z, _)
				end

				if a >= D and not t51.swinging then
					D = a + 1
					t43.status = ("%s  ·  +%d this Bloom"):format(L, t51.gain())
				end
			end
		end

		t51.release(d, M, I)

		return B
	end
	t51.run = function()
		local a, d, M, I = t51.prepare()

		if not a then
			return false
		end

		local Q = tonumber(v5034("NetReach", 14)) or 14
		local T = math.min(Q - 3, (tonumber(v5034("DodgeRadius", 9)) or 9) + 1)
		local L, x = nil, false

		while t51.keepGoing(d, M, "Tween") do
			local h = math.max(math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), CLAMP), 0.004166666666666667)
			local S = t51.target
			local z = t51.pos(S)

			if not z or os.clock() - t51.since > 3 then
				if z then
					t51.skip[S] = os.clock() + 2
				end

				S = t51.pick(d.Position)
				t51.target, t51.since = S, os.clock()
				z = t51.pos(S)

				if S then
					local k = t43.tiers()

					t43.status = ("Chasing %s  ·  +%d this Bloom"):format(k and k[S.Name] and k[S.Name].name or S.Name, t51.gain())
				end
			end

			if not z then
				L = L or os.clock()

				if os.clock() - L > 2 then
					break
				end

				d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				v70(d.Position)
			else
				L, x = nil, true

				local R = math.clamp(v69(), t4.MIN_SPEED, t4.MAX_SPEED)
				local F = d.Position - z
				local L = F.Magnitude > 0.001 and (z + F.Unit * T) or (z + Vector3.new(T, 0, 0))
				local F = t51.moveStep(a, M, d, L, z, R, h)

				if F and (z - F).Magnitude <= Q - 1.5 then
					t51.swing(S, z)
				end
			end
		end

		t51.release(d, M, I)

		return x
	end

		end

		if t57.hollowLeft() > 0 then
			return true
		end

		if t57.eligibleAt and os.clock() - t57.eligibleAt < 10 then
			return t57.eligible
		end

		local R = v5873(a)
		local F, z = pcall(function()
			return a.Elig == nil or a.Elig.IsEligible(tonumber(R and R.SpeedPower) or 0)
		end)

		t57.eligible, t57.eligibleAt = F and z == true, os.clock()

		return t57.eligible
	end
	t57.join = function(a)
		if os.clock() - t57.lastJoinTry < 2 then
			return
		end

		local W = genv.__SenaV4TreadmillManager
		local s, d = pcall(function()
			return W and not W.destroyed and W:isEngaged() == true
		end)

		if s and d then
			t57.status = "Leaving treadmill for the race"

			return
		end

		t57.lastJoinTry = os.clock()

		local s = a.Remotes.TheHollow and a.Remotes.TheHollow.AskEnter

		if t57.hollowLeft() > 0 and s then
			local W, d, M = pcall(function()
				return s:InvokeServer()
			end)

			t57.status = (W and d) and "Joining The Hollow" or ("The Hollow refused: " .. tostring(W and (M or d) or d))

			return
		end

		local s = Workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
		local W = s and s:FindFirstChild("RaceRallyPortal")
		local _, s, d = v8()

		if not W or not s then
			return
		end

		local _ = a.RR and Workspace:GetAttribute(a.RR.Attributes.JoinEndsAt)

		t57.joinTries = (t57.joinWindow == _ and t57.joinTries or 0) + 1
		t57.joinWindow = _

		if t57.joinTries > 2 and d then
			local a = W:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
			local F = pcall(function()
				return a:IsA("BasePart") and a.Position or a:GetPivot().Position
			end)

			if F and _ and (s.Position - _).Magnitude > 12 then
				t57.status = "Going to the race portal"

				local function a()
					return not v20() or not senaV4Config.RaceAuto or t57.inRace() or t57.joinLeft() <= 0
				end

				pcall(v629, s, d, CFrame.new(_ + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), a, false, nil, false)

				if t57.inRace() then
					return
				end
			end
		end

		for a, a in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
			if a:IsA("BasePart") and a.CanTouch then
				pcall(firetouchinterest, s, a, 0)
				task.wait()
				pcall(firetouchinterest, s, a, 1)
			end
		end

		t57.status = "Joining Race Rally"
	end
	t57.findControls = function()
		if t57.controls then
			return t57.controls
		end

		if os.clock() - (t57.lastControlsSearch or 0) < 1 then
			return nil
		end

		t57.lastControlsSearch = os.clock()

		if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.getupvalue) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end

		pcall(function()
			for a, a in ipairs(getgc(false)) do
				if type(a) == "function" then
					local F, R = pcall(debug.info, a, "s")

					if F and R and R:find("MountController") then
						local F, R = pcall(debug.info, a, "n")

						if F and R == "Step" then
							for F = 1, 6 do
								local R, z = pcall(debug.getupvalue, a, F)

								if R and type(z) == "table" and rawget(z, "activeController") ~= nil and z.GetMoveVector ~= nil then
									t57.controls = z

									return
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		return t57.controls
	end
	t57.releaseControls = function()
		local a = t57.controls

		if a and rawget(a, "GetMoveVector") == t57.finishMove then
			a.GetMoveVector = nil
		end

		local F = a and rawget(a, "activeController")

		if type(F) == "table" and F.moveVector == t57.finishInput then
			F.moveVector = Vector3.zero
		end

		t57.finishMove, t57.finishInput = nil, nil
	end
	t57.setFlags = function(a, F)
		if not (a and a.Flags) then
			return
		end

		t57.savedFlags = t57.savedFlags or {}

		for R, z in pairs(F) do
			local F = a.Flags[R]

			if type(F) == "table" and rawget(F, "Value") ~= nil then
				if t57.savedFlags[R] == nil then
					t57.savedFlags[R] = F.Value
				end

				F.Value = z
			end
		end
	end
	t57.restoreFlags = function(a)
		if not (a and a.Flags and t57.savedFlags) then
			return
		end

		for F, R in pairs(t57.savedFlags) do
			local z = a.Flags[F]

			if type(z) == "table" and rawget(z, "Value") ~= nil then
				z.Value = R
			end
		end

		t57.savedFlags, t57.flagsSet = nil, nil
	end
	t57.baseTop = function(a)
		local F = a and a.Flags and a.Flags.TopSpeed

		return tonumber(F and (rawget(F, "DefaultValue") or (t57.savedFlags and t57.savedFlags.TopSpeed) or F.Value)) or 120
	end
	t57.multiplier = function()
		return math.clamp(tonumber(senaV4Config.RaceSpeedMultiplier) or 1, 0.5, 5)
	end
	t57.glideMode = function()
		return senaV4Config.RaceMode == "Path Glide"
	end
	t57.glideSpeed = function()
		return math.clamp(tonumber(senaV4Config.RaceGlideSpeed) or 420, 60, 6000)
	end
	t57.glideStep = function(q, F)
		local R = t57.path
		local z = q.Rig
		local L = z and z.Root

		if not R or not L then
			return
		end

		if q:IsHeld() then
			t57.glideDist = nil

			return
		end

		if not t57.glideDist then
			local _, s = pcall(R.Project, R, L.Position, 0, R.Length, R.Length)

			t57.glideDist = _ and type(s) == "number" and s or 0
		end

		local _ = t57.glideSpeed()

		t57.glideDist = t57.glideDist + _ * math.min(F, 0.1)

		local F = R:FrameAt(t57.glideDist)
		local s = R:FrameAt(t57.glideDist + 20)
		local R = F.UpVector
		local W = s.Position - F.Position
		local s = W.Magnitude > 1e-3 and W.Unit or F.LookVector
		local W = z.Mount and z.Mount:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
		local z = (W and W.Size.Y / 2 or 2) + 0.5 - (W and (W.Position - L.Position):Dot(R) or 0)

		if not t57.roadParams then
			local W = t57.track()
			local d = RaycastParams.new()

			d.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
			d.FilterDescendantsInstances = { W and W:FindFirstChild("Track") }
			t57.roadParams = d
		end

		local W = Workspace:Raycast(F.Position + R * 40, -R * 80, t57.roadParams)
		local a = W and (W.Position + R * z) or (F.Position + R * (z + 2))

		L.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, a + s, R)
		L.AssemblyLinearVelocity = s * _
		L.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		if q.Drive.Enabled then
			q.Drive.Enabled = false
		end

		q.Push.Force = Vector3.new(0, L.AssemblyMass * Workspace.Gravity, 0)
		q.Align.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, s, R)
		q.Up, q.Heading, q.TravelDirection, q.Speed = R, s, s, _
		q.Grounded, q.AirSeconds, q.Launched = true, 0, false
	end
	t57.glideOverride = function(a, F)
		local R = pcall(t57.glideStep, a, F)

		if not R then
			a.Override = nil
			t57.glideDist = nil
		end
	end
	t57.skywhaleActive = function()
		local a = v5869()
		local R = (a and a.Power and a.Power.Attributes) or {}
		local a = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(R.Effect or "RacePowerUpEffect")
		local z = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(R.EffectEndsAt or "RacePowerUpEffectEndsAt")

		return a == "Skywhale" and type(z) == "number" and Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < z + 0.5
	end
	t57.antiTrap = function(a)
		if not a then
			return
		end

		if rawget(a, "Override") ~= nil then
			if not t57.skywhaleActive() then
				a.Override = nil

				if t57.lastHeading then
					a.Heading, a.TravelDirection = t57.lastHeading, t57.lastHeading
				end

				if t57.lastMountSpeed and t57.lastMountSpeed > 0 then
					a.Speed = math.max(t57.lastMountSpeed, tonumber(a.Speed) or 0)
				end

				t57.stuns = (t57.stuns or 0) + 1
			end
		else
			t57.lastHeading = a.Heading or t57.lastHeading
			t57.lastMountSpeed = a.Speed or t57.lastMountSpeed
		end
	end
	t57.findMount = function()
		local a = t57.mount

		if a and typeof(a.Drive) == "Instance" and a.Drive.Parent then
			return a
		end

		t57.mount = nil

		if os.clock() - (t57.lastMountSearch or 0) < 0.5 then
			return nil
		end

		t57.lastMountSearch = os.clock()

		local a

		if type(filtergc) == "function" then
			local F, R = pcall(filtergc, "table", { Keys = { "Holds", "Drive", "Align", "Push", "Heading", "TravelDirection" } }, false)

			if F and type(R) == "table" then
				a = R
			end
		end

		if not a and type(getgc) == "function" then
			a = {}
			pcall(function()
				for F, F in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
					if type(F) == "table" and rawget(F, "Holds") ~= nil and rawget(F, "Drive") ~= nil and rawget(F, "Align") ~= nil then
						a[#a + 1] = F
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		if type(a) ~= "table" then
			t57.status = "Your executor can't ride the race (no filtergc/getgc)"

			return nil
		end

		for F, F in ipairs(a) do
			if typeof(F.Drive) == "Instance" and F.Drive.Parent then
				t57.mount = F

				break
			end
		end

		return t57.mount
	end
	t57.hazards = function()
		local a = os.clock()

		if t57.hazardCache and a - t57.hazardAt < 0.2 then
			return t57.hazardCache
		end

		local R = {}
		local z = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RacePowerUpFX")

		for F, F in ipairs(z and z:GetChildren() or {}) do
			local z, L = pcall(function()
				return F:IsA("Model") and F:GetPivot().Position or F.Position
			end)

			if z and typeof(L) == "Vector3" then
				R[#R + 1] = { pos = L, radius = 8 }
			end
		end

		local F = t57.track()
		local z = F and F:FindFirstChild("Map") and F.Map:FindFirstChild("Creatures")

		for F, F in ipairs(z and z:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if F:IsA("Model") and F.Name:find("Arm") then
				local z, L = pcall(function()
					return F:GetBoundingBox()
				end)

				if z and L then
					R[#R + 1] = { pos = L.Position, radius = math.min(math.max(_.X, _.Z) / 2, 20) }
				end
			end
		end

		t57.hazardCache, t57.hazardAt = R, a

		return R
	end
	t57.findJumps = function()
		t57.jumpProgs, t57.jumpedAt = {}, {}

		local a, F = t57.path, t57.track()

		if not a or not F then
			return
		end

		for R, R in ipairs(F:GetDescendants()) do
			if R:IsA("Model") and R.Name == "Jump" then
				local F, z, L = pcall(function()
					return R:GetBoundingBox()
				end)

				if F and z and L then
					local F = a:Project(z.Position, 0, a.Length, a.Length) % a.Length
					local R

					for _, _ in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
						for s, s in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
							for W, W in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
								local d = z:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(L.X * _, L.Y * s, L.Z * W))
								local z, L = pcall(a.Project, a, d, F, 250, 250)

								if z and type(L) == "number" then
									L = L % a.Length

									local z = (F - L) % a.Length

									if z < 400 and (not R or z > (F - R) % a.Length) then
										R = L
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					t57.jumpProgs[#t57.jumpProgs + 1] = ((R or F) - 8) % a.Length
				end
			end
		end
	end
	t57.legitStep = function(a, R)
		local z = t57.findControls()
		local L = t57.path
		local _ = LocalPlayer.Character
		local s = _ and _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not z or not L or not s then
			return
		end

		if R and R.Touch ~= true then
			R.Touch = true
		end

		t57.antiTrap(R)

		local W = t57.baseTop(a) * t57.multiplier()

		if t57.flagsSet ~= W then
			t57.flagsSet = W
			t57.setFlags(a, { TopSpeed = W, AccelSeconds = 0.3, AirFallSeconds = 9999, WallSpeedKeep = 0.95, BrakeSeconds = 3 })
		end

		local a = s.Position
		local W = os.clock()

		if not t57.legitProg or W - (t57.legitFull or 0) > 0.5 then
			local d, M = pcall(L.Project, L, a, 0, L.Length, L.Length)

			if d and type(M) == "number" then
				t57.legitProg = M % L.Length
			end

			t57.legitFull = W
		else
			local d, M = pcall(L.Project, L, a, t57.legitProg, 40, 120)

			if d and type(M) == "number" then
				t57.legitProg = M % L.Length
			end
		end

		local d = t57.legitProg

		if not d then
			return
		end

		local M = _:FindFirstChild("RaceMount")
		local _ = (M and M:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")) or s
		local M, I = _.CFrame.LookVector, _.CFrame.UpVector
		local _ = s.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		local s = L.Length
		local Q = L:FrameAt((d + math.clamp(_ * 0.35, 25, 60)) % s)
		local T, x = 0, false

		for h, h in ipairs(t57.hazards()) do
			local k, B = pcall(L.Project, L, h.pos, d, 10, 110)

			if k and type(B) == "number" then
				local k = (B % s - d) % s

				if k > 5 and k < 110 then
					local k = L:FrameAt(B % s)
					local L = (h.pos - k.Position):Dot(k.RightVector)
					local B = (a - k.Position):Dot(k.RightVector)
					local k = h.radius + 9

					if math.abs(L - B) < k then
						local h = math.clamp(L + (B >= L and k or -k), -22.0, 22)

						if not x or math.abs(h - B) > math.abs(T) then
							T = h
						end

						x = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local L = Q.Position + Q.RightVector * T - a
		local a = M - I * M:Dot(I)
		local M = L - I * L:Dot(I)
		local L, Q = 0, -1.0

		if a.Magnitude > 0.01 and M.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			a, M = a.Unit, M.Unit

			local T = math.atan2(a:Cross(M):Dot(I), a:Dot(M))

			if x then
				L = math.clamp(-T * 2.2, -1.0, 1)
			elseif math.abs(T) > math.rad(25) then
				L = math.clamp(-T * 1.2, -1.0, 1)
			end

			if math.abs(T) > math.rad(100) then
				L = T > 0 and -1.0 or 1
				Q = _ > 40 and -0.3 or -1.0
			end
		end

		t57.legitSteer = (t57.legitSteer or 0) + (L - (t57.legitSteer or 0)) * 0.35
		t57.finishInput = Vector3.new(t57.legitSteer, 0, Q)

		if rawget(z, "GetMoveVector") ~= t57.finishMove then
			t57.finishMove = function()
				return t57.finishInput or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
			end
			z.GetMoveVector = t57.finishMove
		end

		local a = rawget(z, "activeController")

		if type(a) == "table" then
			a.moveVector = t57.finishInput
		end

		if R and type(R.Jump) == "function" then
			for a, a in ipairs(t57.jumpProgs or {}) do
				if (a - d) % s <= 10 and _ > 40 and (t57.jumpedAt[a] or 0) < W - 3 then
					t57.jumpedAt[a] = W
					pcall(R.Jump, R)
				end
			end
		end

		t57.status = string.format("Racing x%.2f (%d studs/s)  ·  Lap %s  ·  Place %s", t57.multiplier(), math.floor(_), tostring(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RaceLap") or "?"), tostring(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RacePlace") or "?"))
	end
	t57.drive = function(a)
		if t57.active then
			return
		end

		t57.active = true
		t57.mount, t57.stuns, t57.powerUps = nil, 0, 0
		t57.legitProg, t57.jumpProgs, t57.controls, t57.flagsSet = nil, nil, nil, nil

		local s = t57.track()

		t57.path = nil

		if s and s:FindFirstChild("AttachmentTrack") then
			local W, d = pcall(a.Path.new, s.AttachmentTrack)

			t57.path = W and d or nil
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while v20() and senaV4Config.RaceAuto and t57.inRace() and type(v5871(a, "FinishPlace", "RaceFinishPlace")) ~= "number" do
				pcall(function()
					local F = settings().Physics

					if F.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle == Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.Always then
						t57.pausedThrottle = t57.pausedThrottle or F.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle
						F.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.DefaultAuto
					end
				end)

				local F = t57.findMount()

				if t57.glideMode() then
					if F and not F:IsHeld() and rawget(F, "Override") ~= t57.glideOverride then
						if rawget(F, "Override") ~= nil then
							t57.stuns = (t57.stuns or 0) + 1
						end

						F.Override = t57.glideOverride
					end

					if not t57.glideFlags then
						t57.glideFlags = true
						t57.setFlags(a, { AirFallSeconds = 9999 })
					end

					t57.status = string.format("Path Glide %d studs/s  ·  Lap %s  ·  Place %s", t57.glideSpeed(), tostring(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RaceLap") or "?"), tostring(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RacePlace") or "?"))
				else
					if F and rawget(F, "Override") == t57.glideOverride then
						F.Override = nil
						t57.glideDist = nil
					end

					if not t57.jumpProgs then
						t57.findJumps()
					end

					pcall(t57.legitStep, a, F)
				end

				task.wait()
			end

			if t57.mount and rawget(t57.mount, "Override") == t57.glideOverride then
				t57.mount.Override = nil
			end

			t57.glideDist, t57.glideFlags, t57.roadParams = nil, nil, nil
			t57.releaseControls()
			t57.restoreFlags(a)

			if t57.pausedThrottle then
				local F = t57.pausedThrottle

				t57.pausedThrottle = nil
				pcall(function()
					settings().Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = F
				end)
			end

			local F = v5871(a, "FinishPlace", "RaceFinishPlace")
			local s = v5871(a, "FinishTime", "RaceFinishTime")

			if type(F) == "number" then
				t57.lastResult = string.format("Place #%d in %s at x%.2f (%d stuns blocked)", F, type(s) == "number" and string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(s / 60), math.floor(s % 60)) or "?", t57.multiplier(), t57.stuns or 0)
			end

			t57.active, t57.mount, t57.path = false, nil, nil
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			local F = a.Power and a.Power.Attributes or {}

			while v20() and t57.active do
				pcall(function()
					local R = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					local S = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(F.Item or "RacePowerUp")
					local L = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(F.RollEndsAt or "RacePowerUpRollEndsAt")
					local s = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(F.Effect or "RacePowerUpEffect")
					local W = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(F.EffectEndsAt or "RacePowerUpEffectEndsAt")
					local F = type(L) == "number" and R < L
					local L = type(s) == "string" and type(W) == "number" and R < W
					local R = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if type(S) == "string" and not F and not L and R then
						a.Remotes.MountRace.PowerUp:FireServer("Use", R.Position, R.CFrame.LookVector)
						t57.powerUps = (t57.powerUps or 0) + 1
						task.wait(1)
					end
				end)
				task.wait(0.4)
			end
		end)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while v20() do
			pcall(function()
				local a = v5869()

				if not a then
					t57.status = "Race data not loaded"

					return
				end

				if not senaV4Config.RaceAuto then
					if not t57.active then
						t57.status = "Off"
					end

					return
				end

				if t57.inRace() then
					if t57.hollowLeft() <= 0 then
						t57.racedRound = t57.roundId() or t57.racedRound
					end

					local S = v5871(a, "FinishPlace", "RaceFinishPlace")

					if type(S) == "number" then
						if t57.leftFor ~= S and not t57.active then
							t57.leftFor = S
							task.wait(2)
							a.Remotes.MountRace.AskLeave:FireServer()
							t57.status = "Finished, leaving the track"
						end
					else
						t57.leftFor = nil
						t57.drive(a)
					end
				elseif t57.joinLeft() > 0 and t57.racedThisRound() then
					t57.status = "Already raced this Race Rally, waiting for the next one"
				elseif t57.joinLeft() > 0 then
					local S = t57.joinLeft() > t57.JOIN_LATE_SECONDS and t57.fieldSettling() or nil

					if S then
						t57.status = S == math.huge and "Race open, waiting for the field to reopen" or string.format("Race open, checking new eggs (%ds)", math.ceil(S))
					else
						t57.join(a)
					end

			function B.refresh()
				v6134()

				if not D.Parent then
					return
				end

				local z = math.floor(D.AbsoluteSize.X - 16)

				if z < 120 then
					return
				end

					table.sort(L, function(_, d)
						local M, T = h(_), h(d)

							return M > T
						end

						return (_.rnum or 0) > (d.rnum or 0)
					end)
				end

				B.counts[B.world] = #L

				local _ = B.world == "Normal" and "Halloween" or "Normal"

				if d then
					B.counts[_] = #M
				end

					end
				end

				for M, Q in pairs(B.queued) do
					if Q == B.world and not _[M] then
						B.queued[M] = nil
					end
				end

				w.Text = ""

				end

				end

					B.emptyLabel:Destroy()
					B.emptyLabel = nil
				end

					for s, s in pairs(B.cards) do
						s.f:Destroy()
					end

					B.cards = {}
					B.emptyLabel = I(a, { text = B.world == "Halloween" and "No Halloween eggs on the field right now." or "No eggs on the field right now.", size = 12, color = W.muted, dim = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32) })

		end

	hopHunt.hop = function()
		if hopHunt.busy then
			return
		end

		hopHunt.busy = true

		local a = hopHunt.state

		a.visited[game.JobId] = true
		a.active = true
		a.hops = a.hops + 1
		a.sinceAsk = a.sinceAsk + 1
		a.period = hopHunt.period()
		hopHunt.save()
		hopHunt.status = "Hopping... (" .. a.sinceAsk .. " / " .. a.limit .. ")"
		pcall(function()
			local R = queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport)

			if R then
				R(hopHunt.bootCode)
			end
		end)

		local R = t58.hopWindow

		if R then
			pcall(function()
				R:SaveConfig("HopSession")
			end)
		end

		local R = {}

		for z, z in ipairs(t58.collectServers(nil) or {}) do
			if not a.visited[z.id] then
				R[#R + 1] = z
			end
		end

		local z = t58.hopToList(R)

		if not z then
			a.hops = math.max(0, a.hops - 1)
			a.sinceAsk = math.max(0, a.sinceAsk - 1)
			hopHunt.save()
			hopHunt.status = "No fresh server found, retrying shortly"
			hopHunt.statusUntil = os.clock() + 8
			hopHunt.nextTry = os.clock() + 8
		end

		hopHunt.busy = false
	end
	hopHunt.stop = function(a)

			hopHunt.elevate()

		end
	end
